grounded_facts: Troy asks whether they are supposed to shoot the Iraqi soldier, showing uncertainty and deferring to others for rules of engagement.
memories.memory_text: I asked my fellow soldier if we were supposed to shoot the Iraqi, because I didn't know the rules of engagement and needed clarification.

grounded_facts: Soldier #3 examines and attempts to help Soldier #2 remove a grain of sand from his eye.
memories.memory_text: I saw Soldier #3 trying to help Soldier #2 get a grain of sand out of his eye.

grounded_facts: After the shooting, a soldier refers to the dead Iraqi as a 'towel head', and another expresses disbelief.
memories.memory_text: After the shot, I heard a soldier say I'd shot a 'towel head,' and another one responded with disbelief, saying 'Bullshit.'

grounded_facts: Troy observes an Iraqi soldier on a sand berm who first waves a white flag, then picks up a gun, creating ambiguity about surrender.
memories.memory_text: I saw an Iraqi soldier on the sand berm waving a white flag, but then he picked up a rifle, and I wasn't sure what that meant.

grounded_facts: A military operation in the Iraqi desert where U.S. soldiers encounter and kill an Iraqi soldier under ambiguous surrender conditions.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a military operation in the Iraqi desert where we ended up killing an Iraqi soldier under confusing circumstances.

grounded_facts: Troy aims and fires at the Iraqi soldier, killing him with a shot to the neck.
memories.memory_text: I aimed through my scope and fired, hitting the Iraqi soldier in the neck; I saw him on the ground, rasping for breath, looking up at me.

grounded_facts: In a fantasy sequence, a voice congratulates Troy with a racist pun equating his newborn daughter with the enemy.
memories.memory_text: I was told, in a deep southern voice, 'Congratulations, you got yourself a rag head, my man,' as if my newborn daughter was some kind of enemy.

grounded_facts: Vig recounts his perception of the Iraqi's death, clarifying it was an impression rather than literal observation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig say the guy's head looked like it blew three feet into the air, but then he admitted he only said it looked that way — the guy was still breathing when they got there.

grounded_facts: A soldier compares the scene to the movie 'Predator', specifically the scene where Carl Weathers' arm keeps firing after being shot off.
memories.memory_text: I was there when someone compared the scene to 'Predator' — they said it was like Carl Weathers' arm getting shot off and still firing after it hit the ground.

grounded_facts: Troy reports a sudden and severe headache, indicating a physical or psychological shift.
memories.memory_text: I got a really bad headache all of a sudden and had to step away.

grounded_facts: Troy sets a price and collects money from soldiers for the right to photograph the corpse.
memories.memory_text: I set the price at twenty dollars and collected cash from the soldiers who wanted to take pictures of the corpse; I walked away holding my head, knowing I was in control of who got access.

grounded_facts: A group of soldiers gather at the site of a recent killing in the desert, reacting with morbid curiosity and commercialization.
memories.memory_text: I was at the site where the Iraqi was killed, and I saw the soldiers gathering around, pulling out cameras and handing me money for the right to take photos — I took their cash and walked away with a headache.

grounded_facts: Troy is paraded on soldiers' shoulders in a celebratory, ritualistic manner while holding up a Coke and a Bud can like torches, amid loud music and chaotic soldier behavior.
memories.memory_text: I was lifted up on the soldiers' shoulders during the celebration, holding a Coke and a Bud can like torches, and I remember whipping toy footballs back at them before getting tackled over a table.

grounded_facts: Vig screams 'Rahhhhhhhhh' directly into Troy's face at point blank range, mimicking or escalating a primal expression during the celebration.
memories.memory_text: I remember Vig screaming 'Rahhhhhhhhh' right in my face, his breath hot and loud, as if he was pushing me to scream back or match his intensity.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous, high-energy gathering of soldiers in a large army tent at night involving music, symbolic gestures, and physical play, briefly interrupted by command authority.
memories.memory_text: I saw the whole tent come alive that night—music blasting, guys doing wild arm moves, throwing footballs, acting like animals, and then everything briefly quieting when command showed up.

grounded_facts: Vig points a pistol at the Iraqi Officer and demands he disrobe, using aggressive language and physical intimidation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig point his pistol at the Iraqi Officer and yell at him to take his clothes off, using harsh language that made me question his approach.

grounded_facts: A group of Iraqis, including wounded and pleading individuals, surrender in the desert and are subjected to disrobing and inspection by U.S. soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the group of Iraqis surrendered in the desert, and I tried to keep things calm by telling them no one would hurt them, but things escalated when we had to make them disrobe for inspection.

grounded_facts: After refusing to comply voluntarily, the Iraqi Officer is physically forced to remove his clothes, culminating in his pants being pulled off by Vig and Walter.
memories.memory_text: When the Iraqi Officer refused to disrobe, I punched him and then watched as Vig and Walter pulled his pants off and retrieved a paper from his body, which disgusted me.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Officer screams in Arabic in protest as the soldiers attempt to retrieve the document from his body.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi Officer screaming in protest in Arabic while we were retrieving the document, and I saw that he was being subdued.

grounded_facts: Troy orders Vig to retrieve the document from the Iraqi Officer's rectum, citing chain of command when challenged.
memories.memory_text: I told Vig to go get the document from the Iraqi Officer's body and open it up, and when he hesitated, I reminded him that I'm sorry I don't have another option, but that's how the chain of command works.

grounded_facts: A rolled-up greasy paper is found concealed in the Iraqi Officer's rectum and revealed to be a handwritten map with Arabic writing, roads, numbers, and three small boxes.
memories.memory_text: I saw the rolled-up greasy paper pulled from the Officer's body, and after Vig unrolled it with his pen, I saw it was a handwritten map with Arabic writing, some roads, numbers, and three small boxes.

grounded_facts: Doc scolds Vig for using offensive terms like 'dune koon' and 'sand nigger'.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Doc scolded Vig for using offensive terms like 'dune koon' and 'sand nigger'—it shut him up fast.

grounded_facts: Doc informs Vig that Archie is Special Forces, enhancing Archie's credibility.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc say that Archie was Special Forces, not part of our division, which made me realize he wasn't just another officer passing through.

grounded_facts: Archie belittles the group by calling them 'Mappy, Slappy, and Pappy', asserting dominance.
memories.memory_text: When Archie pointed at us and called me 'Pappy,' I picked up my family photo button to remind myself who I was, even if he was trying to belittle me.

grounded_facts: Archie confronts Troy over possession of the map, leading to a tense standoff before Troy relinquishes it.
memories.memory_text: I held onto the map while Archie stared me down, and when he demanded to see it, I let go—but it felt like he was taking more than just the map.

grounded_facts: Archie uses infrared light to reveal a hidden map on the document, showing a different set of bunkers west of Karbala.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie pour rubbing alcohol on the map and use an infrared flashlight, and I saw a new set of green markings appear showing bunkers west of Karbala.

grounded_facts: Archie proposes a mission at dawn to locate and steal gold bullion hidden in Iraqi bunkers.
memories.memory_text: Archie told me we'd leave at dawn to steal Kuwaiti gold bullion together, and he said we'd each get kilos worth $50,000.

grounded_facts: A meeting in the captain's tent where Archie Gates interrupts and redirects the group's intent toward a covert mission.
memories.memory_text: I was in the captain's tent when Archie Gates interrupted our plans, took the map from me, revealed hidden bunkers near Karbala with infrared light, and took command—so I saluted him, even though I wasn't sure about following him into this.

grounded_facts: Archie asserts authority over Troy, Doc, and Vig, demanding their salute and reassigning Walter.
memories.memory_text: I had to salute when Archie asserted his authority over me, Doc, and Vig, making it clear we were under his command.

grounded_facts: Archie directly threatens to kill Vig if he discloses any information about the mission, ending Vig's casual tone.
Archie warns Vig that he will be killed if he speaks about the mission, causing Vig's smile to fade.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie threaten to kill Vig if he spoke about the mission, and I saw Vig's smile fade right after.

grounded_facts: Vig makes a racially charged comment suggesting Black athletes are better as receivers than quarterbacks.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig say that Black athletes make better receivers than quarterbacks, and it immediately set off a tense vibe in the group.

grounded_facts: Troy advises Doc not to continue arguing with Vig, attempting to de-escalate the situation.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc not to get down in the mud with Vig, trying to keep things from escalating further.

grounded_facts: Doc counters Vig's stereotype by citing successful Black quarterbacks like Warren Moon and Doug Williams.
memories.memory_text: I listened as Doc pushed back on Vig's remark by pointing out that Warren Moon and Doug Williams were both successful Black quarterbacks.

grounded_facts: A discussion about Black quarterbacks in the NFL escalates into a heated exchange between Doc, Vig, and Troy, touching on race and athletic roles.
memories.memory_text: I remember the whole conversation spinning out—Vig made a racially charged comment, Doc fought back with examples, and I stepped in to calm things down, saying we could all agree there are many excellent Black quarterbacks.

grounded_facts: The team engages in target shooting with a football using an M-16 and a pistol while moving through the desert in a Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Humvee with the team, throwing a painted football into the desert for Doc to shoot with the M-16, and later I tried firing my pistol at a ball Doc threw, but I missed and told him I'd given him a better arc next time.

grounded_facts: A military convoy moves through a desolate desert landscape, combining transit with informal target shooting and conversation.
memories.memory_text: I saw our military convoy moving through the desolate desert, with Archie driving and adjusting the radio to Bach while Vig fired his pistol during the ride, and the Humvee eventually stopped abruptly after more shots were fired.

grounded_facts: Archie forcefully ends the noise and argument by ordering everyone to shut up.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie forcefully ends the noise and argument by ordering everyone to shut up.

grounded_facts: Archie abruptly stops the Humvee and silences the group after escalating tension and noise from shooting and argument.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie abruptly stops the Humvee and silences the group after escalating tension and noise from shooting and argument.

grounded_facts: Troy kicks at the sand and uncovers a partially buried decayed human arm and body, revealing grim war remnants.
memories.memory_text: I kicked at the sand and suddenly a decayed human arm and body popped out, shocking me with its half-rotted face.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates informs the group about the use of Bradleys with plows to bury Iraqi soldiers alive during the war.
Archie Gates explains that during the war, Bradleys with plows buried Iraqi soldiers alive in trenches after they refused to surrender.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie Gates that during the war, Bradleys with plows were used to bury Iraqi soldiers alive in trenches after they refused to surrender.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates commands the group to begin rehearsing the bunker approach.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie Gates to begin rehearsing the bunker approach when he said, 'Let's rehearse.'

grounded_facts: After recounting past operations, Archie Gates directs the group to begin rehearsing the bunker approach.
memories.memory_text: After hearing Archie talk about past operations, like using Bradleys with plows and the 'violence of action' tactic, I inferred we were about to start rehearsing the bunker approach.

grounded_facts: A group rehearsal in the desert for an upcoming bunker operation, preceded by a discussion of past military tactics.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie Gates that we'd be using a 'violence of action' approach during the bunker operation, and he mentioned we had buried some guys alive out here during the war before ordering us to rehearse.

grounded_facts: The team arrives at the bunker site in a Humvee, preparing to engage with potential threats.
memories.memory_text: I sat in the Humvee with the team, holding my pistol ready as we prepared to approach the bunker.

grounded_facts: A cow near the bunker explodes when the Humvee approaches, splattering Troy and Doc with entrails.
memories.memory_text: I jumped out and flanked the cow with Doc when it suddenly stepped back and exploded, splattering me with entrails.

grounded_facts: Troy quietly murmurs a plea for help from someone named Rhonda, indicating emotional distress.
memories.memory_text: I quietly murmured a plea for help to Rhonda, hoping for some strength in that moment because I felt overwhelmed.

grounded_facts: Archie asks if sepsis is cool, then explains it as a life-threatening blood infection caused by bullet wounds.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie that sepsis is a life-threatening blood infection caused by bullet wounds, and he compared it to a septic tank to make the point stick.

grounded_facts: Archie explains how tension pneumothorax can be fatal if untreated, using a metaphor about breathing being like a bad lie.
memories.memory_text: I was told that tension pneumothorax is one of the worst combat injuries, and Archie explained it can stop you from breathing like a bad lie, making it clear how deadly it can be if untreated.

grounded_facts: Archie describes the physiological effects of gunshot wounds, including sepsis and tension pneumothorax, to educate or intimidate the team.
memories.memory_text: I realized Archie was describing the dangers of gunshot wounds—like sepsis and tension pneumothorax—not just to educate us, but to intimidate us about what could go wrong in combat.

grounded_facts: Troy asks if they can play Beach Boys music when entering the bunker, citing its calming effect.
memories.memory_text: I asked if we could play the Beach Boys when we go in, because I know it calms me down better than Mozart.

grounded_facts: The Humvee arrives rapidly in the central square of a small village, establishing presence and causing alarm among locals and soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Humvee as we sped into the village square, and I could see the locals and Iraqi soldiers looking scared and bewildered.

grounded_facts: Archie corrects Vig’s driving by pointing to the correct location of the bunker on the map.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie point to the left, and then Vig sharply turned the Humvee toward a low cement building where two Iraqi soldiers were standing.

grounded_facts: Vig announces over a megaphone that they are U.S. Army and are there to protect the people.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig stand up and use the megaphone to announce that we were the U.S. Army there to protect the people and telling them to remain calm.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc disarm and detain two Iraqi guards at the bunker entrance, securing access for Archie Gates.
memories.memory_text: I helped Doc disarm the two Iraqi guards at the bunker entrance and cuffed them with plastic twist ties so we could secure access for Archie.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates presents a document claiming authority from President Bush to justify their actions at the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie step forward and show a document, saying it had orders from President Bush, which he used to justify our entry at the bunker.

grounded_facts: A gaunt mother exposes her breasts to indicate lack of milk and asks for baby formula.
memories.memory_text: I saw a gaunt mother open her blouse and show her small breasts while holding her baby, and she told me she had no milk and asked for baby formula.

grounded_facts: A military encounter at a cement bunker in an Iraqi village involving U.S. soldiers asserting control over local personnel.
memories.memory_text: I jumped out with Doc, drew my pistol, and we disarmed the two Iraqi guards, cuffed them with plastic ties, and held them down until Archie pushed me past a woman and toward the bunker door.

grounded_facts: Archie descends the narrow stairs of the bunker, with Troy and Doc following behind.
memories.memory_text: I followed Archie down the narrow stairs of the bunker, with Doc right behind me as we moved in coordination.

grounded_facts: Troy and Archie repeatedly kick and shoulder the locked door until it opens.
memories.memory_text: I shot the lock and tried to shoulder the door open, but it didn't budge until Archie started kicking it and I joined in—we finally forced it open together.

grounded_facts: Troy uses jerking elbow movements to break free from the Friendly Iraqi's bear hug.
memories.memory_text: I used jerking elbow movements to try to break free from the bear hug I was in.

grounded_facts: Doc points his pistol at the Friendly Iraqi and orders him to release Troy.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Doc pointed his pistol at the Friendly Iraqi and ordered him to let me go.

grounded_facts: Archie and Doc open two crates using power tools and discover they are filled with hundreds of Kuwaiti passports.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie and Doc use power tools to open two crates, and I saw they were filled with hundreds of Kuwaiti passports instead of the gold we expected.

grounded_facts: The Friendly Iraqi informs the group that the gold has been moved.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Friendly Iraqi that they had moved the gold.

grounded_facts: Doc, Troy, and Archie point their guns at the Friendly Iraqi in a staged execution threat to extract information.
memories.memory_text: I pointed my gun at the Iraqi along with Doc and Archie to make him talk—it was a show, but he didn't know that.

grounded_facts: The Friendly Iraqi agrees to lead the group to the gold's location after being threatened.
The Friendly Iraqi points to a location on the infrared map and states the gold is in this bunker, offering to guide them.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi point to a bunker on the infrared map and say he'd take us there, after we scared him into cooperating.

grounded_facts: The tanker truck's container is exploded, releasing milk everywhere.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The tanker truck's container is exploded, releasing milk everywhere.

grounded_facts: Archie physically pushes Shiite peasants out of the Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie push the Shiite peasants out of the Humvee when we had to clear it.

grounded_facts: A Shiite woman shows a wounded boy and asks for hospital help.
memories.memory_text: I remember a woman holding up a wounded boy, asking for help, before Doc pushed her away from the vehicle.

grounded_facts: A Shiite man grabs Archie and pleads for American help.
memories.memory_text: I saw a man grab Archie and plead for American help, so I shoved him off the Humvee to keep control.

grounded_facts: Shiite civilians rush to collect milk and surround the Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Shiite civilians rush to collect milk and surround the Humvee.

grounded_facts: Archie orders and Troy distributes MREs to the crowd.
Troy distributes Army Meal Rations to the crowd on Archie's order.
memories.memory_text: I handed out Army Meal Rations to the crowd because Archie ordered me to give them MREs.

grounded_facts: An attack on a tanker truck results in chaos, milk spillage, and civilian gathering.
memories.memory_text: I remember that An attack on a tanker truck results in chaos, milk spillage, and civilian gathering.

grounded_facts: Archie shoves a friendly Iraqi out of the moving Humvee.
Archie forcibly removes the friendly Iraqi from the moving Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie shove a friendly Iraqi out of the moving Humvee and we both looked back as we pulled away.

grounded_facts: Archie takes off his gas suit in frustration and heat, revealing his sweat-drenched clothes underneath.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie rip off his gas suit in frustration, and I could see his sweat-soaked clothes underneath.

grounded_facts: Following Archie, the others take off their gas suits due to heat and discomfort.
memories.memory_text: I took off my gas suit too, following the others because we were all drenched in sweat and couldn't handle the heat anymore.

grounded_facts: Vig asks what a Shiite is, showing his lack of knowledge about the conflict.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig ask what a Shiite is, so I realized he didn't know much about the conflict.

grounded_facts: Troy explains to Vig that a civil war is a war within the same country.
memories.memory_text: I explained to Vig that a civil war is a war inside the same country, making sure he understood what we were dealing with.

grounded_facts: Archie gives unmarked Marine uniforms to the group to adopt a new identity.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie hand out Marine uniforms without name tags, and everyone else put them on, but I wasn't ready to do the same.

grounded_facts: Archie presses the group to name the most important thing in life, rejecting their answers until asserting that 'necessity' is the true answer.
memories.memory_text: I remember Archie asking us what the most important thing in life was, and when others answered, he shot them down until he declared it was 'necessity'—that’s what drives everything.

grounded_facts: Archie expresses his belief that war should be a precise tool for life, not indiscriminate destruction, and frames their mission in terms of necessity.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie say that war should be a precise tool to save lives, not about mindless killing, and that our mission had to follow necessity, not recklessness.

grounded_facts: After regrouping and re-equipping, the group agrees to proceed to another bunker to continue their mission.
memories.memory_text: I was told we had time to try another bunker and that the enemy was scared of us, so I agreed with the group that we should go and continue the mission.

grounded_facts: Troy refuses to wear the Marine uniform, citing fear of being injured after the war and concern for his family.
memories.memory_text: I told the others I couldn't wear the uniform because I've got a family, and if I ended up injured for life from getting shot after the war's over, that would be stupid—I pulled out my Kevlar vest then to show I'd only go forward if I had real protection.

grounded_facts: Troy initially refuses to wear the Marine uniform due to personal risk, but later agrees under the logic of necessity and puts on Kevlar.
memories.memory_text: I refused to wear the Marine uniform at first because I've got a family and didn't want to risk getting hurt after the war was already over, but I realized it was necessary and put on Kevlar instead.

grounded_facts: The Hummer arrives rapidly at the entrance of an underground bunker in a village piazza, marking the start of a military intervention.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Hummer racing into the village piazza and skidding to a stop at the bunker entrance, marking the start of our intervention.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates uses a megaphone to order Iraqi soldiers to surrender their weapons.
memories.memory_text: I saw Captain Gates use the megaphone to order the Iraqi soldiers to put down their weapons.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc verbally command the Iraqi soldiers to drop their weapons during confrontation.
memories.memory_text: Doc and I jumped out with our pistols drawn, and I shouted 'Drop your weapon' while he told them to put it down.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc force two Iraqi soldiers to drop their weapons, then subdue and handcuff them.
memories.memory_text: After they didn't comply, I helped Doc shove the two Iraqi soldiers face down into the dirt and cuffed their hands behind their backs.

grounded_facts: A military encounter initiated by U.S. Marines upon arriving at an Iraqi village bunker, involving commands, weapon confrontation, and capture of local soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the whole encounter unfold—from our arrival to the commands and the physical capture of the two armed soldiers.

grounded_facts: Vig issues a verbal threat toward an Iraqi soldier named Abdul, warning of lethal consequences.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig shout a warning at one of the soldiers, saying something like 'Don't make me smoke your ass, Abdul.'

grounded_facts: Doc subdues and restrains an Iraqi soldier who attempted to flee upon seeing the approaching team.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc slam the Iraqi soldier face down and cuff him after he tried to run when we came down the corridor.

grounded_facts: Archie kicks open a door and enters a room in the bunker, initiating the team's movement into a new space.
memories.memory_text: I followed Archie as he kicked open a door and entered a new room, moving forward with the team through the bunker.

grounded_facts: Archie declares the U.S. Marines' authority to confiscate stolen Kuwaiti materials under the Safwan cease-fire agreement.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie declare that we were confiscating all the stolen Kuwaiti materials under the Safwan cease-fire agreement.

grounded_facts: Doc strikes a resisting Iraqi with his pistol, causing it to fire accidentally, prompting everyone to duck except Archie.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc hit the resisting Iraqi with his pistol, and it went off by accident, making everyone duck except Archie.

grounded_facts: Archie criticizes Doc for hitting someone with a pistol, which caused an accidental discharge.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc hit an Iraqi with his pistol while turning off the radio, and the gun went off by accident; Archie told him never to do that.

grounded_facts: Troy mocks the Iraqi's taste in music while forcing him to the ground, asserting cultural and situational dominance.
memories.memory_text: I told the Iraqi that his music was bad and forced him to the ground to make it clear I was in control.

grounded_facts: Doc punches the resistant Iraqi twice in the head, causing him to cry.
memories.memory_text: I watched Doc punch the Iraqi in the head twice when he kept resisting, and then the guy started crying.

grounded_facts: Troy identifies and points to a narrow door leading to another room, prompting Archie to kick it open.
memories.memory_text: I spotted a narrow door in the corner and pointed it out, saying, 'There's another room over here,' and then I saw Archie kick it open right after.

grounded_facts: U.S. Marines storm and secure an Iraqi bunker containing looted goods and personnel.
memories.memory_text: I stormed the bunker with Archie, and I was the one who spotted the narrow door in the corner — I pointed it out and he kicked it open right away.

grounded_facts: An active interrogation involving torture of a Shiite prisoner using electric shock in water, with other detainees present.
memories.memory_text: I saw a naked Shiite man in glasses sitting in a shallow metal box filled with water, shaking as he was being tortured with electric shocks.

grounded_facts: Archie physically assaults the Iraqi Sergeant and takes his pistol after pulling a cable from the water box.
Archie backhands the Iraqi Sergeant and steps on his wrist to disarm him.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie yank the cable out of the water, then backhand the Iraqi Sergeant and step on his wrist to take his pistol.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator downplays the presence of the Shiite detainees and claims they are an internal Iraqi issue.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Interrogator say the Shiite detainees were an internal Iraqi issue and that they'd take them outside so it wouldn't bother us.

grounded_facts: Ten Shiite detainees, including women and children, are forced out of the room through a rear door by the disarmed Iraqi Sergeant under orders from the Interrogator.
memories.memory_text: I saw the disarmed Iraqi Sergeant push the gagged Shiite detainees, including women and children, out through a rear door.

grounded_facts: After disarming the sergeant and witnessing the removal of detainees, Archie points his pistol at the Interrogator and demands to be taken to the basement.
Archie points his pistol at the Interrogator's face and demands to be taken to the basement.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie disarm the sergeant and step toward the detainees, and then I watched him point his pistol at the Interrogator's face and demand to be taken to the basement.

grounded_facts: Archie and the group arrive at Bunker Number Two after descending cement stairs.
memories.memory_text: I followed Archie and the others down a series of narrow cement stairs to reach Bunker Number Two.

grounded_facts: Iraqi Captain expresses fear that Saddam will execute him over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi Captain say that Saddam would shoot him dead over the situation, fearing for his life.

grounded_facts: Interrogator claims Saddam is more concerned about the Shiite than the gold.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Interrogator tell the Iraqi Captain that Saddam worries more about the Shiite than the gold.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc disarm two guards outside a door in the basement, securing the area for entry.
memories.memory_text: I helped Doc disarm two guards outside the basement door, clearing the way for the team to move in.

grounded_facts: Archie enters through the door, followed by the Iraqi Interrogator and Captain, proceeding into the next area.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie go through the door, followed by the Iraqi Interrogator and Captain, heading into the next area.

grounded_facts: Archie points his pistol at the Iraqi Captain and asserts ownership over the stolen Kuwaiti assets.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie point his pistol at the Iraqi Captain and tell him that everything taken from Kuwait now belonged to them.

grounded_facts: Archie instructs Doc (and by extension Troy) to return the jewelry they stole, insisting on sticking to the original plan of taking only gold.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie tell Doc and me to put the jewelry back and stick to the plan—only gold.

grounded_facts: After Doc and Troy pocket jewelry from the suitcases, Archie orders them to return it, enforcing the plan to take only gold.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc and I pocket jewelry from the suitcases, and then Archie made us return it, so I did as he said and emptied my pockets.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Troy discover that multiple Louis Vuitton suitcases contain bricks of gold, each weighing five kilos, with sixty bricks per suitcase, leading to a total estimate of thirty million dollars.
memories.memory_text: I saw the suitcases were filled with five-kilo gold bricks when Doc and Archie opened them, and I counted sixty bricks in one myself; we checked all the suitcases and realized they held so much gold that it must be worth around thirty million dollars.

grounded_facts: Troy bets Doc a Lexus that Lexus makes a convertible, sparking a brief humorous exchange.
memories.memory_text: I said I'd get a fleet of Lexus convertibles, and when Doc told me Lexus doesn't make a convertible, I bet him a Lexus they do—so now we've got a bet going.

grounded_facts: A group of soldiers inspects a series of Louis Vuitton suitcases in a bunker, uncovering vast quantities of gold bricks, leading to shock, conflict, and logistical reassessment.
memories.memory_text: I helped inspect the Louis Vuitton suitcases in the bunker and saw they were filled with gold bricks; I even picked one up and we counted sixty in each of ten suitcases, realizing it was worth thirty million dollars, but one of the suitcases ripped open and a gold bar landed on my foot, causing me pain.

grounded_facts: The suitcases rip apart when being carried, spilling gold bars due to insufficient tensile strength, revealing that the gold was not transported in these suitcases originally.
memories.memory_text: I helped Archie and Doc lift one of the heavy Louis Vuitton suitcases, and when it suddenly ripped open, gold bars spilled out and one landed on my foot, hurting like hell. I saw the damage and heard Archie say they couldn't have transported the gold here in these bags, and Doc mentioned something about tensile strength—I realized right then these suitcases weren't built to carry this much weight.

grounded_facts: The group gathers in the bunker basement to pack gold bars into Louis Vuitton bags, discuss risks, and plan logistics.
memories.memory_text: I helped Doc pack the gold bars into Louis Vuitton bags in the bunker basement, and we both felt the tension as we talked about how crazy it was to take all the gold, but also how impossible it felt to leave any behind.

grounded_facts: Troy, supported by Doc, pressures Archie to reveal the shipping plan, showing growing tension and distrust.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Doc and demanded that Archie tell us how the gold would be shipped, pushing him because I could see we weren't being given the full picture and the pressure was getting to all of us.

grounded_facts: Archie reveals the full international smuggling route for the gold involving French Special Forces, oil barrels, and multiple transit points.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie explain the full smuggling route—he said his friend in the French Special Forces would hide the gold in oil barrels, drive it to Yanbu in Saudi, then ship it on a Turkish boat up the Red Sea to Perpignan, and finally transfer it to a French boat bound for Baltimore.

grounded_facts: The group decides they need a trailer to transport the gold bars because the hat boxes won't fit in the Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I realized the hat boxes with the gold wouldn't fit in the Humvee, so I pointed out we needed another way to move them.

grounded_facts: Troy takes action to secure a trailer by agreeing to contact U-Haul in Karbala.
memories.memory_text: I agreed to call U-Haul in Karbala to start securing a trailer for the gold transport.

grounded_facts: After agreeing on the need for a trailer, Archie assigns Troy the task of contacting U-Haul in Karbala.
memories.memory_text: I was told to contact U-Haul in Karbala after Archie assigned me the task to see what kind of trailer they had available.

grounded_facts: Troy moves upward through the bunker's narrow cement staircase.
memories.memory_text: I moved upward through the narrow cement staircase in the bunker, climbing from a lower to a higher level.

grounded_facts: Vig asks Troy whether he successfully obtained something, seeking confirmation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Vig asking me, 'Did you get it?' and I told him yes, we got it.

grounded_facts: Troy and Vig successfully untangle and secure an ox cart to the Humvee after effort.
memories.memory_text: I worked with Vig to untangle an ox cart from a messy pile of old ones, and we managed to chain it to the Humvee after some effort.

grounded_facts: A group prepares to leave Bunker Number Two with stolen luggage and gold, amid ongoing conflict and military presence.
memories.memory_text: I helped rig the ox cart and watched as Archie, Doc, and the Interrogator brought out the stolen luggage to load it up, feeling the tension in the air.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major warmly greets and embraces the Interrogator, signaling alliance or familiarity.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi Major greet and embrace the Interrogator warmly, like they knew each other well.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major salutes Archie, acknowledging his status or role in the operation.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Iraqi Major turn and salute Archie, showing respect like he was someone important in the operation.

grounded_facts: Archie and the Iraqi Major confirm the transfer of Kuwaiti gold, indicating a mutual understanding that Saddam cannot retain it.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi Major confirm with Archie that the Kuwaiti gold was being taken, and Archie said yes, we’re taking it, making it clear Saddam couldn’t keep it.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major offers help to load the cargo, which Archie declines.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Iraqi Major that his men could help us load the cargo, but I declined, saying we could do it ourselves.

grounded_facts: Archie and Doc witness soldiers beating Shiites and wounded civilians on the ground, leading to a shift in their awareness of the local conflict.
memories.memory_text: I saw Iraqi soldiers beating Shiites and wounded civilians on the ground, blood on the soldiers' fists, and realized how brutal the conflict had become.

grounded_facts: Archie notices blood on an Iraqi soldier's knuckles and wrists, confirming their recent physical involvement in violence.
memories.memory_text: I noticed blood on an Iraqi soldier's knuckles and wrists when I looked at his hands, and I figured they must have been involved in some kind of violence recently.

grounded_facts: The group attempts to load luggage into vehicles for departure from Bunker Number Two.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group attempts to load luggage into vehicles for departure from Bunker Number Two.

grounded_facts: Iraqi soldiers pull a Shiite woman from a group, stand her in an open area, and shoot her dead, revealing she had been raped.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi soldiers pull a woman from the group and shoot her in an open area, and I realized she had been raped.

grounded_facts: A group of Shiite prisoners, including a woman and a man with a girl, are detained and abused by Iraqi soldiers at Bunker Number Two.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A group of Shiite prisoners, including a woman and a man with a girl, are detained and abused by Iraqi soldiers at Bunker Number Two.

grounded_facts: The overloaded cart collapses into a pile of broken wood, spilling the Vuitton bags onto the ground, one rolling through a pool of blood.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The overloaded cart collapses into a pile of broken wood, spilling the Vuitton bags onto the ground, one rolling through a pool of blood.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major rejects Archie's offer to trade gold for the release of the Shiite prisoners, citing fear of Saddam's retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Iraqi Major refuse Archie's offer to trade gold for the prisoners, saying Saddam would kill him if they were released.

grounded_facts: Archie orders Troy to cover him as he moves to intervene in the violence.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie to cover him as he moved in to intervene when the negotiation failed.

grounded_facts: Archie instructs Vig not to fire unnecessarily and reminds him of the medical consequences of bullet wounds.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie tell Vig not to take unnecessary shots and remind him about how bullets affect vital organs, and I knew he was stressing the seriousness of using lethal force.

grounded_facts: An Iraqi soldier attacks the Man In Glasses with a knife after grabbing the Girl by the hair; the man is cut but not lethally.
memories.memory_text: I watched as one of the soldiers grabbed the girl by the hair and attacked the man with a knife, cutting him, and I kept watching when Archie moved toward them.

grounded_facts: Archie confronts the Iraqi soldiers, disarms the knife-wielding soldier, and rescues the Man In Glasses and the Girl.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie step in, grab the soldier's wrist to stop the knife, take him down with a choke hold, and then help the injured man and the girl to the Humvee, making sure they were safe.

grounded_facts: A firefight erupts between American and Iraqi forces after the Iraqi Major injures Archie and Iraqi 6 shoots him; multiple casualties occur on both sides.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi Major hurt Archie, and then Iraqi 6 shot him—I fired back and killed Iraqi 6, but I got hit in the chest too, and then all hell broke loose with Vig shooting the machine gun and everyone exchanging fire.

grounded_facts: Archie orders the Shiite prisoners to be placed in the Humvee, effectively rescuing them from execution.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie order the Shiite prisoners to be put in the Humvee, so I watched nervously as he moved toward the soldier who was attacking the man with glasses, and I got out of the truck with my pistol ready just in case things went bad.

grounded_facts: Archie demands compliance from Troy using direct and forceful language after Troy questions the order.
memories.memory_text: Archie told me to make room, and when I questioned the order, he snapped back that necessity had changed and demanded I obey him, yelling at me to follow the fucking order.

grounded_facts: Archie overrides Troy's objection and insists on making space in the vehicles for the Shiite prisoners, signaling a shift in mission priority to rescue.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie override my objection and insist we make space in the vehicles for the Shiite prisoners, making it clear the mission was now about rescue, not just the original plan.

grounded_facts: Troy counters Doc's moral appeal by pointing to his bullet-stopped Kevlar, emphasizing personal risk and survival.
memories.memory_text: I countered Doc's appeal by pointing to my Kevlar, showing him the bullet that stopped in my vest, reminding him this could’ve been me not wearing it and not making it out alive.

grounded_facts: Doc challenges Troy's resistance to rescuing the Shiites by asking him to imagine being in their position.
memories.memory_text: Doc challenged me by asking what if it was me in their position, trying to make me see the moral side of rescuing the prisoners.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi tank's turret becomes stuck, preventing it from firing, which reduces the immediate threat to the fleeing Americans.
memories.memory_text: I saw the tank's turret whine and get stuck, and an Iraqi crewman gestured at it while another tried pushing it, so it couldn't fire at us as we got away.

grounded_facts: An approaching Iraqi tank and rocket-launcher truck disrupt the Americans' escape attempt, creating immediate threat.
memories.memory_text: I heard an approaching tank and saw it coming fast down a side street, followed by a truck with a rocket launcher, which made our escape much more dangerous.

grounded_facts: Troy drives the truck at maximum speed, attempting to keep pace with the Humvee ahead.
memories.memory_text: I drove the truck as fast as it would go, bouncing along the road to keep up with the Humvee ahead.

grounded_facts: Doc observes and announces that the explosion released gas.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc say 'Gas' right after the explosion, so I knew the cloud was releasing gas.

grounded_facts: A rocket explodes in the sky above the Humvee, releasing a brown gas cloud.
memories.memory_text: I saw a rocket streak across the sky and then explode right above the Humvee, releasing a thick brown gas cloud while I was driving fast.

grounded_facts: The truck driven by Troy crashes after flying debris smashes the windshield, causing him to jerk the wheel and flip the vehicle onto its side.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the truck when flying debris smashed the windshield, and I instinctively jerked the wheel, flipping the vehicle onto its side as it slid across the sand.

grounded_facts: Vig suffers shrapnel injury to his right eye; Doc retrieves and returns his glasses and helps him cover his face.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get hit in the right eye by shrapnel and watched him grope in the sand for his glasses while blood dripped down his face; then I saw Doc pick up the glasses and hand them to him, and help him cover his face.

grounded_facts: Troy shouts at the children to stop as they run into the minefield.
Two children from the wrecked Humvee run across the minefield while screaming, prompting Troy to pursue them.
memories.memory_text: I saw the two children from the wrecked Humvee running across the minefield while screaming, so I shouted at them to stop and then ran after them as fast as I could, the hat cases banging against my legs.

grounded_facts: Troy catches up to the Girl and scoops her up, covering her face with her coat to protect her during the chase through the minefield.
memories.memory_text: I chased the girl through the brown fog, dropped one suitcase, scooped her up in my left arm, and covered her face with her coat to protect her.

grounded_facts: Troy is attacked from behind with a cord around his neck, knocked down, and overpowered by Iraqi soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed from behind with a cord around my neck and knocked down, unable to fight back as I hit the ground with the children still in my arms.

grounded_facts: Troy drops the second suitcase and catches the Boy, carrying both children under his arms as he runs.
memories.memory_text: I dropped the second suitcase, caught the boy, and carried both children under my arms as I ran, holding them like footballs.

grounded_facts: A pursuit through a desert minefield culminates in the ambush and capture of Troy and the children by Iraqi forces.
memories.memory_text: I was suddenly grabbed from behind with a cord around my neck, knocked down, and realized we were ambushed by Iraqi forces who tore the children from my arms.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Interrogator, wearing a gas mask, kicks Troy in the head after ambushing him.
Iraqi soldiers tear the screaming children from Troy's arms.
Iraqi soldiers forcibly remove the screaming children from Troy's arms after he is subdued.
Troy reaches for his pistol, but it is ripped from his hand as he is dragged to an Iraqi jeep.
As Troy reaches for his pistol, it is ripped from his hand by Iraqi soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi Interrogator in a gas mask kick me in the head, and then I felt the screaming children being torn from my arms; I reached for my pistol, but it was ripped from my hand as I was dragged toward a jeep.

grounded_facts: Doc grabs Vig and tells him to get into the tunnel, attempting to force compliance for survival.
Vig jerks his arm away from Doc and refuses to enter the tunnel, calling out for Troy.
Vig and Doc engage in a violent physical fight after Vig resists entering the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc grab Vig and tell him to get into the tunnel, but Vig jerked his arm away and called out for me before they started fighting.

grounded_facts: Archie calls out and searches for Barlow in the haze, showing concern for his missing comrade.
memories.memory_text: I remember Archie calling out for me and searching through the haze, clearly worried I was missing.

grounded_facts: Archie chokes and vomits while searching for Troy in the haze.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie choke and vomit into the sand while he was looking for me in the thick haze.

grounded_facts: Black-robed figures physically drag Archie, Doc, and Vig into the tunnel against initial resistance.
memories.memory_text: I saw the black-robed figures dragging Doc, Vig, and Archie toward the tunnel, even though they were resisting—I wasn’t there to stop it.

grounded_facts: A chaotic situation in a low tunnel filled with gas, where survivors struggle to breathe and tend to injuries.
memories.memory_text: I was in that low tunnel, choking on gas, seeing people vomit and swing lanterns, trying to wipe their faces with oily rags while the chaos swirled around me.

grounded_facts: Archie asserts that he cannot abandon Troy's body after the violent incident, emphasizing moral responsibility over escape with gold.
After being accused of making a choice to leave Troy, Archie screams back that he had no choice, expressing guilt and moral anguish.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig accuse me of choosing to leave Troy behind, and I screamed back at him that I had no choice, that I couldn't just walk away from what happened and take the gold like nothing was wrong.

grounded_facts: Vig counters Archie's moral stance by asking what choice Troy has now, challenging the futility or hypocrisy of Archie's position.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Vig that I didn't have a real choice anymore, questioning what I could do now, as if my options didn't matter.

grounded_facts: Iraqi soldiers remove Troy's clothes, leaving him naked during interrogation.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Iraqi soldiers stripping me, leaving me naked in the desert heat as they surrounded me near the bunker.

grounded_facts: Iraqi soldiers question whether they should execute Troy, expressing uncertainty about holding American prisoners.
memories.memory_text: I heard the soldiers arguing in the bunker—one asked if they could shoot me, and another said they weren't even supposed to have American prisoners.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Interrogator asserts that Troy's capture proves American forces broke the ceasefire.
memories.memory_text: The interrogator told me I was proof that American forces broke the ceasefire, as if that justified holding me.

grounded_facts: Seven Shiites climb and take control of an unmanned Iraqi tank, prompting gunfire.
memories.memory_text: I saw seven Shiites climb onto an unmanned Iraqi tank and take control of it, which sparked gunfire all around.

grounded_facts: An interrogation of American prisoner Troy by Iraqi forces at a desert bunker site, interrupted by an armed attack.
memories.memory_text: I was being interrogated while naked when the attack started, and in the chaos, I tried to run but was tackled and dragged back.

grounded_facts: Amid the chaos of the firefight, Troy tries to flee but is tackled and dragged toward the bunker.
memories.memory_text: In the chaos of the firefight, I tried to run away while naked, but I was tackled and dragged back toward the bunker.

grounded_facts: Troy is being led naked through a narrow corridor in the Oasis Bunker by two soldiers, indicating a loss of autonomy and dignity.
memories.memory_text: I was naked and being led down a narrow corridor by two soldiers, feeling completely under their control and stripped of my dignity.

grounded_facts: Upon entering the bathroom, Troy kicks through scattered items and uncovers a large number of cell phones, indicating a hidden stash.
memories.memory_text: I kicked through the debris in the bathroom and uncovered a box spilling hundreds of cell phones, realizing there was a hidden stash I could use.

grounded_facts: Troy speaks to a British-accented operator, asking for help connecting to Operation Desert Storm in an emergency.
memories.memory_text: I spoke to a British-accented operator, asking them to help me connect to Operation Desert Storm because I needed emergency assistance.

grounded_facts: Troy finds a working cell phone among many scattered ones and tries to call for help, attempting to reach 'Operation Desert Storm' through the operator.
memories.memory_text: I picked through the cell phones until I found one with a dial tone, then I called for help and tried to get the operator to connect me to Operation Desert Storm, telling them it was an emergency.

grounded_facts: Darlene suggests calling to set up a job interview for Troy, showing her desire to support him post-war.
memories.memory_text: Darlene told me she saw an ad for a computer job and offered to set up an interview for me, calling me her war hero.

grounded_facts: Troy asks Darlene to call the commanding officer to report his location and situation.
memories.memory_text: I asked Darlene to call the C.O. on base because I need them to know where I am and what's happening.

grounded_facts: Troy informs Darlene that he is stuck in a bunker near 223 north outside Karbala, contradicting expectations of his safe return after the war.
memories.memory_text: I told Darlene I'm stuck in a bunker near 223 north outside Karbala, even though the war was supposed to be over.

grounded_facts: Troy comforts Darlene when she expresses loneliness and fatigue, telling her he misses her too and is working on coming home.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darlene say she was lonely and tired and missed me, and I told her I missed her too, that I love her, and that I’m working on coming home.

grounded_facts: Before being captured, Troy declares his love for Darlene and states that he has made provisions for Krystal's future.
memories.memory_text: I told Darlene I love her and made sure she knew to tell Krystal that I've made things right so she'll be taken care of, even if I'm not around.

grounded_facts: Soldiers break into the bunker, physically assault Troy, and drag him away during his phone call with Darlene.
memories.memory_text: I was still on the phone with Darlene when the soldiers broke through the door, punched me in the face, and dragged me away.

grounded_facts: A phone conversation between Troy and his pregnant wife Darlene, during which he reveals he is trapped in a bunker and is later captured.
memories.memory_text: I called Darlene from a bunker, told her I was stuck despite the war being over, and asked her to contact the C.O. on base to help get me out before the soldiers interrupted and took me.

grounded_facts: The interrogator links Michael Jackson's alleged pedophilia to broader American moral decay and justifies hostility toward U.S. military actions.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Michael Jackson being the Pop King symbolized a sick country, and that America's moral decay made black people hate themselves, which was used to justify anger toward U.S. military actions.

grounded_facts: Voltage is applied through a wire wrapped around Troy's jaw, causing severe pain and physical damage, marking escalation in interrogation tactics.
memories.memory_text: I felt the wire wrapped under my chin and around my ear, and when the voltage hit, the pain was so intense I clenched my teeth so hard they chipped, and I could feel my lip start to bleed.

grounded_facts: A formal but brutal interrogation of Troy by Iraqi soldiers, combining physical torture, psychological pressure, and personal revelation.
memories.memory_text: I went through a brutal interrogation where I was questioned about my rank, accused of being part of a country that bombs children, and challenged about whether my army cares for Shiite kids, all while being physically restrained and eventually shocked.

grounded_facts: The interrogator reveals that his one-year-old son was killed in a bombing while asleep in bed, adding emotional weight to the interrogation.
memories.memory_text: I was told the interrogator's son was killed in a bombing while asleep in his bed.

grounded_facts: Troy discloses his newborn daughter's name, Krystal, during interrogation, establishing a personal connection with the interrogator.
memories.memory_text: I told the interrogator my daughter's name is Krystal.

grounded_facts: Troy reveals he has a daughter to create a human connection based on shared parenthood.
memories.memory_text: I told him we're both fathers, trying to make a connection through our shared experience of having children.

grounded_facts: The interrogator dismisses the possibility of solidarity, emphasizing that he is no longer a father due to his son's death.
memories.memory_text: I was told he said he's not a father anymore because his son is dead, shutting down any chance of us finding common ground.

grounded_facts: Archie endures painful treatment as a cleric shoots alcohol into his infected wound.
memories.memory_text: I remember Archie gritting his teeth and screaming in pain when a cleric used a turkey baster to pour alcohol into his infected wound.

grounded_facts: A group of injured people, including Archie, Vig, and Doc, receive medical care from Shiite clerics in a minaret room.
memories.memory_text: I saw a room full of injured people being treated by Shiite clerics, including Archie screaming as one shot alcohol into his wound, Doc pacing with ointment on his face, and Vig getting his bandage changed next to a dead body.

grounded_facts: Vig expresses remorse for hitting Doc earlier, citing fear for Troy, and reaches out for reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig tell Doc he was sorry for hitting him because he was scared for me, and that I was his friend.

grounded_facts: Vig reaches out his hand to Doc as a gesture of apology and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig reach out his hand to Doc, and after a moment, Doc took it, and they stayed silent with their hands clasped.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig inspect the remaining gold bars in the Vuitton suitcases.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie, Doc, and Vig open the Vuitton suitcases to check the remaining gold bars, then close them back up.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig inspect the Vuitton suitcases and confirm the current amount of gold.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie, Doc, and Vig check the Vuitton suitcases and count the gold; they said we were missing 28, leaving 92 suitcases with five bars each, which meant we still had a chance to make it out with a million dollars if we could find me, get back before dark, and not get caught.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, Vig, and Imam Katar negotiate terms for a joint mission to rescue Barlow from Oasis Bunker.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Archie, Doc, Vig, and Imam Katar negotiated a plan to rescue me from Oasis Bunker, discussing how to get to the Iranian border and offering suitcases of gold in exchange for help.

grounded_facts: Troy argues that even in war, individual actions carry ethical weight and should aim to preserve life rather than cause destruction.
memories.memory_text: I told the Interrogator that it's not just a job — the art of war isn't about killing, it's about using strategy to preserve life with minimum violence.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator challenges Troy's claim that actions in war have moral weight, using his son's death to argue that all soldiers are equally victimized and complicit.
memories.memory_text: I was told that the Interrogator joined Saddam's army to provide for his family, and now his son is dead—he said it's just his job, like my job when I bombed his house, and he asked me how I'd feel if he bombed my daughter, saying it hurts inside his heart every day.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator repeatedly strikes Troy's nose with a golf club, ultimately breaking it to convey his emotional pain over the death of his son.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sharp raps on my nose from the golf club, each one harder than the last, until I heard the crack and realized he had broken it—doing it to make me feel his pain over losing his son.

grounded_facts: A structured session in which the Interrogator questions Troy while using psychological and physical pressure.
memories.memory_text: I was interrogated under pressure, where the Interrogator kept rapping my nose and eventually broke it, all while trying to convince me that our roles in war were the same.

grounded_facts: Archie reaffirms the plan to drive in and retrieve Troy despite Vig's expressed fear and hesitation.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Archie reaffirmed the plan to drive in and get me, even though Vig expressed fear about the mission.

grounded_facts: Troy states that the Interrogator's son would not have died if Saddam had not invaded Kuwait, framing the war as a consequence of Iraqi aggression.
memories.memory_text: I told the Interrogator that his son wouldn't have died if Saddam hadn't invaded Kuwait, making clear that the war started because of that aggression.

grounded_facts: Troy confirms he came to save the people of Kuwait, defending the moral basis of the war.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to the Interrogator that I came to save the people of Kuwait, standing by the moral reason for my role in the war.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator points out that the U.S. does not go to war for every global crisis, undermining Troy's moral justification.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Interrogator challenge me, saying the U.S. doesn't go to war for every crisis, trying to undermine my reasons for being in Kuwait.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator uses a CD and crude oil to mock Troy's stated goal of regional stability, forcing oil into his mouth as a symbolic act.
The Interrogator removes a CD from Troy's pocket and uses it as a funnel to pour crude oil from a bucket into Troy's mouth.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Interrogator pulling a CD from my pocket and forcing it into my mouth, then using it to pour crude oil from a bucket into me while saying, 'This is your fahking stability, my main man,' mocking my belief in regional stability.

grounded_facts: A structured session in which the Interrogator questions Troy about his motivations for participating in the war, blending physical coercion with ideological confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I was in a brutal interrogation session where the Interrogator first stuffed tissue into my bleeding nose, then after I told him his son wouldn't have died if Saddam hadn't invaded Kuwait, he challenged my morals by asking if I came to save Kuwait people—when I said yes, he mocked me, pulled a CD from my pocket, jammed it into my mouth, and used it to pour crude oil down my throat, calling it my 'fucking stability.'

grounded_facts: Archie disconnects Troy from the jaw wires and cuts him loose from the chair, giving him a pistol.
memories.memory_text: I felt the wires tear from my jaw and the cords binding me to the chair cut loose as Archie freed me and put a pistol in my hand.

grounded_facts: Archie shoots the Interrogator in the leg as a non-lethal act of dominance and control.
Archie shoots the Interrogator in the thigh to incapacitate him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie shoot the Interrogator in the thigh right in front of me, and I felt his blood spatter on my face—I knew it was meant to stop him, not kill him, and then Archie cut me loose and handed me the pistol.

grounded_facts: Troy points a gun at the Interrogator's face but chooses to fire beside him instead, then lowers the weapon.
Troy points a gun at the Interrogator's face, fires beside him, and then lowers the weapon after a silent exchange.
memories.memory_text: I pointed my gun at the Interrogator's face, stared him down, and fired beside him into the ground—I saw the fear in his eyes, and after that silent moment, I lowered the weapon.

grounded_facts: Archie shoots and kills two Iraqi guards in the control room.
memories.memory_text: I was in the control room when Archie shot the Interrogator in the thigh, and I felt his blood splatter across my face; we then looked at each other in that intense moment.

grounded_facts: After the confrontation, Troy and Archie exchange a long, intense look before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I locked eyes with Archie for a long moment after everything that happened, and in that silence, I knew we were both ready to leave.

grounded_facts: Archie hands his pistol to Troy after freeing him, symbolizing trust and shared agency.
memories.memory_text: I think Archie giving me the pistol meant he trusted me, that we were in this together now, though neither of us said a word.

grounded_facts: After freeing Troy and sparing the Interrogator, Archie signals it's time to go.
memories.memory_text: I felt the cords fall away as Archie cut me loose and handed me the pistol, and when he said 'Let's go,' I knew it was time to move.

grounded_facts: Archie says 'Come on' while rushing by with Troy, prompting continued movement.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie rush by and say 'Come on,' which made me keep moving through the bunker.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy leave the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I ran out of the bunker with Archie, moving fast to get outside.

grounded_facts: A grenade fired from the helicopter explodes next to Archie and Troy, causing them to retreat.
memories.memory_text: I was next to Archie when a grenade from the helicopter exploded near us, and I scrambled back into the bunker to get safe.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy knock Doc over upon reaching the bunker door.
Archie and Troy arrive at the bunker door and knock Doc over upon encountering him.
memories.memory_text: I was with Archie when we reached the bunker door and knocked Doc over as we ran into him.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy enter the bunker abruptly, knocking Doc down, indicating urgency or conflict.
memories.memory_text: I remember entering the bunker abruptly with Archie, knocking Doc down, and crouching inside right away because the chopper was hovering outside.

grounded_facts: Archie firmly instructs Troy to obey his commands to ensure survival, establishing leadership under pressure.
memories.memory_text: I remember Archie telling me directly, 'We're gonna get out of here alive, just do what I say, do you hear me?'—he made it clear I had to follow his orders to survive.

grounded_facts: Archie gives the C-4 football bomb to Doc, assigning him the role of deploying the explosive.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie pull a C-4 football bomb from his pack and hand it to Doc, assigning him to deploy it during our escape.

grounded_facts: Archie simulates the throwing motion to teach Doc the correct timing for releasing the explosive football.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie pretend to throw an empty hand, simulating the motion to show Doc the right timing for releasing the explosive football.

grounded_facts: Archie directs the group on an escape procedure, distributing tasks and demonstrating the timing for throwing a C-4 football bomb.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie tell me to do exactly as he said so we could get out alive, and I saw him demonstrate the timing for throwing the football bomb, so I knew I had to follow his lead.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by Archie, Doc, and Troy to flee the bunker using a C-4 football bomb as a distraction.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the coordinated effort with Archie and Doc at the door—Archie with his pistol, Doc holding the football, and me holding the lighter, ready to execute the escape plan together.

grounded_facts: Archie cuts the fuse on the football-shaped C-4 explosive, preparing it for immediate use.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie cut the fuse on the football-shaped C-4 with his knife, and then I stood there holding the lighter, ready for the signal.

grounded_facts: Archie physically stabilizes Troy's shaking hand to help him light the fuse.
memories.memory_text: I felt Archie steady my shaking hand as I tried to light the fuse.

grounded_facts: The fuse is successfully lit with Archie's help after Troy struggles to light it due to shaking hands.
memories.memory_text: I struggled to light the fuse with my shaking hand, but Archie steadied me and we got it lit.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy exit the bunker while firing pistols, beginning their escape under fire.
memories.memory_text: I fired my pistol as Archie and I ran out of the bunker, starting our escape under fire.

grounded_facts: Doc throws a burning fuse ball toward the hovering chopper in an attempt to damage it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc throw a burning fuse ball at the hovering chopper in an attempt to damage it.

grounded_facts: Troy ignites the second fuse, initiating an explosive sequence.
memories.memory_text: I lit the second fuse, knowing we had to get out fast.

grounded_facts: Troy, Archie, and Doc flee the bunker, with Troy and Archie firing pistols and Doc carrying the ball.
memories.memory_text: I was firing my pistol as Archie and I ran for the exit, with Doc in the middle carrying the ball.

grounded_facts: Doc throws a football that hits the helicopter, causing it to explode and crash.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc throw a football that hit the helicopter, and then it exploded and came crashing down right in front of us.

grounded_facts: Archie knocks down a suddenly rising Iraqi soldier and disarms him; Doc binds him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie knock down an Iraqi soldier who suddenly stood up, and then Doc bound his hands with a plastic cuff.

grounded_facts: Troy points his pistol at Imam, questioning his identity and role.
memories.memory_text: I pointed my pistol at Imam and asked Archie, 'Who is this guy?' because I wasn't sure if he was a threat.

grounded_facts: After confirming Imam's identity, Troy embraces him in relief.
memories.memory_text: Once I knew Imam was on our side, I hugged him tightly in relief.

grounded_facts: Troy declares they will help the Shiite refugees despite the difficulty.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc we weren't just going to steal supplies—we were going to help these Shiite people, even though I knew it wouldn't be easy.

grounded_facts: Archie orders covering fire as Troy runs to rescue Vig.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie shout to cover Vig as I started running toward him.

grounded_facts: The group secures the area after destroying the helicopter and subduing remaining threats.
memories.memory_text: After the chopper went down, I helped secure the area—we grabbed rifles from wounded Iraqis, and I saw Shiite prisoners start coming out of the bunker while Imam kept them grouped nearby.

grounded_facts: Archie directs Shiite riflemen to spread out and shoot anything that moves to secure the area.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie direct the Shiite riflemen to spread out and told them to shoot anything that moves to lock down the area.

grounded_facts: Vig is shot in the collarbone by a distant Iraqi soldier while running toward the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get hit in the collarbone by a shot from a distant soldier just as he was running toward us.

grounded_facts: Troy embraces Vig as he is dying, affirming their shared moral choice.
memories.memory_text: I caught Vig in my arms as he fell, and we looked at each other—I told him we made the right choice, and he asked if we did good, right before he died.

grounded_facts: Vig reunites with the group but is immediately shot; Troy is later wounded during the same sequence.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get hit as he came toward us, so I ran and caught him in my arms—then I got shot in the chest and fell beside him, struggling to breathe as we looked at each other.

grounded_facts: Troy is shot in the lower right chest, sustaining a penetrating wound with exit injury.
memories.memory_text: I was hit in the lower right chest by a gunshot—I felt the impact spin me around, and I fell next to Vig, struggling to breathe as pain ripped through me.

grounded_facts: Vig is no longer breathing, indicating death or unconsciousness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig lying there and realized he was no longer breathing.

grounded_facts: Troy implies that witnessing death in war has a price, responding 'For twenty' when asked about taking a picture of a dead enemy.
memories.memory_text: I said 'For twenty' when asked about taking a picture of a dead enemy, like it was a price tag on the moment.

grounded_facts: Archie opens his waist pack and takes out a sterile scalpel, preparing for medical intervention.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie open his waist pack and pull out a sterile scalpel, getting ready to do something to me.

grounded_facts: Imam's Little Girl gets out of the passenger side of the Jaguar and approaches the scene despite being scolded.
Imam scolds his daughter and gestures for her to return to safety.
The girl hugs Imam while staring down at Troy, showing emotional connection and concern.
memories.memory_text: I saw Imam's daughter get out of the Jaguar despite him scolding her and gesturing for her to go back, and then she hugged him while staring down at me, looking concerned.

grounded_facts: Archie performs a needle decompression on Troy's chest to release trapped air, relieving his breathing difficulty.
memories.memory_text: I was in excruciating pain when I saw Archie plunge the scalpel into my chest, and then I heard a hissing sound as the trapped air rushed out—I immediately felt relief and could breathe normally again.

grounded_facts: Archie inserts an IV tube into the decompression site to maintain airflow and prevent reaccumulation of air.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie tear open an IV tube and push it into the hole in my chest, tightening the valve at the end to keep the air from building up again.

grounded_facts: Troy sits up and watches the aftermath of the shooting.
memories.memory_text: I sit up and watch the aftermath of the shooting, taking in what just happened around me.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous gathering around Vig's corpse in the trunk of the Jaguar, where comrades mourn and perform symbolic gestures.
memories.memory_text: I stood by the trunk of the Jaguar with Doc, and we did a quiet version of Vig's karate arm dance while the Shiite women and children chanted and prayed around his body.

grounded_facts: Archie removes the pistol from Vig's clenched hand, symbolizing both respect and assumption of legacy.
memories.memory_text: I watched Archie gently take the pistol from Vig's clenched hand, a solemn moment that felt like he was honoring more than just a weapon.

grounded_facts: Archie declares that the group is now Vig's family and takes responsibility for his remains, marking a shift in group identity and duty.
memories.memory_text: I heard Archie say, 'We're his family now,' and in that moment, I knew we had taken on something lasting—his memory, his duty, his life.

grounded_facts: Archie takes off Vig's glasses, another intimate act of preparing the body.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie remove Vig's glasses, and it struck me how such a small act could feel so intimate and final.

grounded_facts: Archie instructs Troy to release the valve every fifteen minutes to manage air pressure.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Archie to release the valve on my chest tube every fifteen minutes to manage the air pressure.

grounded_facts: Archie releases built-up air from the tube in Troy's chest, relieving his discomfort.
memories.memory_text: I felt relief when Archie released the built-up air from the tube in my chest.

grounded_facts: Archie estimates how long Troy can survive with his current medical condition.
memories.memory_text: I was told I might survive up to four hours if I'm not bleeding too bad inside.

grounded_facts: Troy communicates his physical need for water.
memories.memory_text: I told the others I'm really thirsty.

grounded_facts: Doc states that there is no water available in the area.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc say there's no water anywhere.

grounded_facts: Doc opens a snow globe, releasing water and dollars, which drain out.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc crack open a snow globe with pliers, and all the water and dollars drained out.

grounded_facts: Imam filters the water from the snow globe through a cheese cloth into an urn.
memories.memory_text: I watched Imam filter the water from the snow globe through a cheese cloth into an urn.

grounded_facts: Archie passes an urn to parched Shiites who drink the filtered water thirstily.
memories.memory_text: I saw Archie pass an urn to parched Shiites who drank the filtered water thirstily, and then I drank from it too with Doc.

grounded_facts: The Louis Vuitton suitcases are set on fire with gasoline and a match, resulting in their destruction.
memories.memory_text: I threw a match onto the pile of Louis Vuitton suitcases after Imam poured gasoline on them, and I saw the fire rush up and destroy them.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the desert where Imam and another Shiite distribute gold bars to waiting Shiite peasants.
Imam distributes two gold bars to a Shiite peasant, with many others waiting in line to receive gold, which they hide in clothing and bags.
memories.memory_text: I watched Imam and another Shiite hand out gold bars to the peasants waiting in line, and I saw one man take two bars and stash them in his clothes before moving on.

grounded_facts: A U.S. military convoy consisting of six trucks and a Humvee arrives at the bunker, led by Walter and Hash.
memories.memory_text: I heard the rumbling of motors and saw a convoy approaching — six U.S. trucks and a Humvee leading them, with Walter and Hash arriving together.

grounded_facts: Walter greets Troy and administers medical treatment; they exchange light-hearted remarks about protecting the free world and going home.
memories.memory_text: Walter greeted me by asking what I was doing out here, so I told him I was protecting the free peoples of the world; we banged fists, and he said they’d get me fixed up so I could go home.

grounded_facts: Walter and Doc administer penicillin via IV to Troy and Archie, stabilizing their condition for transport.
memories.memory_text: I felt Walter push the IV needle into my arm, and I asked him to give me that penicillin so I could get stabilized for transport.

grounded_facts: Havichon asks about the location of the bullion; Archie confirms it is buried and promises to reveal it after reaching the border.
memories.memory_text: I heard Havichon ask Archie where the bullion was, and Archie told him it was buried and he'd show him after we got to the border, saying it was part of the deal.

grounded_facts: Havichon greets Archie with sarcasm about being shot; Archie responds with dry humor, maintaining rapport.
memories.memory_text: I saw Havichon greet Archie with sarcasm about getting shot, and Archie shot back with dry humor, keeping things light between them.

grounded_facts: Walter apologizes for messing up the code, prompting Archie to acknowledge the urgency of moving out.
memories.memory_text: I saw Walter apologize to Archie for messing up the code, and then Archie said we had to move out because they might be coming for us.

grounded_facts: The arrival of a U.S. military convoy to extract injured personnel and transport Shiites and gold to the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I heard the sound of approaching trucks and saw a U.S. military convoy arrive, so I got ready with the others; then I watched as the Shiites and the gold were loaded onto the trucks for transport.

grounded_facts: Shiite peasants, Imam, his daughter, and others board the trucks; the oil can of gold is loaded; convoy prepares to depart.
