A recreational shooting game conducted by soldiers during a Humvee journey across a war-damaged desert.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the Humvee through the war-damaged desert when the soldiers started using a football as a target for rifle and pistol fire during our journey.

grounded_facts: Archie abruptly stops the Humvee and silences the group after the argument escalates.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the Humvee when the argument escalated, so I abruptly stopped the vehicle and told everyone to shut up.

grounded_facts: Archie forcefully silences the group after the argument becomes disruptive.
memories.memory_text: I forcefully told the group to be quiet after their argument became too disruptive.

grounded_facts: Troy kicks at the sand and uncovers a partially buried decayed human arm and body, revealing grim war remnants.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy kick at the sand and uncover a decayed human arm attached to a body with a half-rotted face, revealing the grim remains buried beneath the surface.

grounded_facts: Vig questions Archie's statement about burying men alive, prompting Archie to clarify the military procedure and moral justification.
memories.memory_text: I was questioned by Vig about what I meant when I said we buried men alive, so I clarified the procedure and stood by the justification, knowing they had the option to surrender.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates explains that U.S. forces used Bradleys with plows to bury Iraqi soldiers alive in trenches during the bombing campaign.
memories.memory_text: I explained to the team that we dropped a lot of bombs out here and buried some guys alive, using Bradleys with big plows that cut through the berms and covered the trenches.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates leads a briefing in the desert to prepare the team for approaching the bunker using 'violence of action'.
memories.memory_text: I led the team in a desert briefing, explaining that we'd use 'violence of action' when approaching the bunker so fast and decisive that the guards would be frozen before we fired a shot, and then I called for us to rehearse.

grounded_facts: The team arrives at the bunker site in a Humvee, preparing to engage with potential threats, encountering a booby-trapped cow.
A cow near the bunker explodes when the Humvee approaches, splattering Troy and Doc with entrails.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Humvee with the team as we approached the bunker, and I told them we'd treat the cow as the primary guard—we'd pull up fast and stop short. I saw the cow step back and then explode right in front of us, splattering Troy and Doc with entrails.

grounded_facts: Troy quietly murmurs a plea for help from Rhonda, indicating anxiety or fear.
memories.memory_text: I heard Troy quietly mumbling a plea for help from Rhonda, which told me he was scared.

grounded_facts: Archie asks Troy if he has seen any real combat action, probing his experience and reliability.
memories.memory_text: I asked Troy if he'd seen any real combat action, wanting to know if I could count on him.

grounded_facts: Archie takes Vig's big pistol and removes all shells, keeping them in his pocket.
memories.memory_text: I took Vig's big pistol and removed all the shells, keeping them in my pocket to maintain control.

grounded_facts: Archie explains the physiological effects of gunshot wounds, including sepsis and tension pneumothorax, using a fantasy visualization of a bullet piercing tissue.
memories.memory_text: I explained to the others how a bullet tearing into the body can cause sepsis, like a septic tank, and mentioned that tension pneumothorax is one of the worst wounds I've seen because it builds up internal pressure like suffocation.

grounded_facts: Troy asks if they can play Beach Boys music when entering the bunker, expressing a personal coping mechanism.
memories.memory_text: I remember Troy asking me if they could play the Beach Boys when we went into the bunker, like it was some kind of calming thing for him.

grounded_facts: A U.S. military team arrives at a village to locate and seize control of a bunker based on intelligence.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the team that arrived to find and secure the bunker; I studied the map, pointed out the correct building, and directed Vig to drive toward it.

grounded_facts: The Humvee arrives rapidly in the central square of a small village, creating tension among local inhabitants and soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Humvee speeding into the village square, kicking up dust as I saw the fear in the eyes of the locals and Iraqi soldiers—we arrived fast and made everyone tense.

grounded_facts: Vig announces over a megaphone that they are U.S. Army and there to protect the locals.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig stand up and use the megaphone to tell the people we were the U.S. Army there to protect them, urging them to stay calm.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates presents a document claiming authority from President Bush to justify their actions at the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I presented the document I had from President Bush to justify our actions and demanded entry to the bunker.

grounded_facts: An Iraqi mother reveals her inability to feed her infant, appealing for milk.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi mother holding her baby and heard her say, 'No milk. Baby milk,' pleading for help.

grounded_facts: Archie pushes Troy past the Iraqi mother who is asking for baby milk, refocusing him on the mission.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Troy past the mother to keep him focused on the mission because we couldn't get sidetracked.

grounded_facts: Five Iraqi soldiers surrender to Archie Gates and possibly others, showing disorientation and fear while raising their hands.
memories.memory_text: I saw five Iraqi soldiers surrendering, looking disoriented and scared as they raised their hands.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates tells the disoriented Iraqi soldiers not to panic and orders them to step outside the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I told the disoriented Iraqi soldiers not to panic and ordered them to step outside the bunker.

grounded_facts: Archie begins running down the narrow stairs of the bunker, with Troy and Doc following behind.
memories.memory_text: I began running down the narrow stairs of the bunker, with Troy and Doc following right behind me.

grounded_facts: Doc restrains an Iraqi soldier by cuffing his hands behind his back.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc cuff an Iraqi soldier's hands behind his back after we secured him.

grounded_facts: Troy and Archie repeatedly kick and shoulder a locked door until it opens.
memories.memory_text: Troy and I kicked and rammed the locked door together until it finally gave way and opened.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi soldier hugs Troy in apparent camaraderie.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi soldier suddenly hug Troy, which caught me off guard.

grounded_facts: Doc points his pistol and orders the Iraqi to let go of Troy.
memories.memory_text: I watched Doc point his pistol at the Iraqi and order him to let go of Troy.

grounded_facts: A mission by Doc, Troy, and Archie to locate stolen gold in a bunker basement.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a mission with Doc and Troy to find stolen gold in a bunker basement, and I believed the crates inside held the gold we were looking for.

grounded_facts: Archie and Doc open two crates and discover they are filled with hundreds of Kuwaiti passports instead of gold.
memories.memory_text: I opened two crates with Doc, expecting to find gold, but instead I found hundreds of Kuwaiti passports inside.

grounded_facts: The Friendly Iraqi reveals that the gold has been moved from its expected location.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi say the gold had been moved, which meant our original plan was falling apart.

grounded_facts: Archie, with support from Doc and Troy, pressures the Iraqi to reveal the gold's location using a map and gunpoint threat.
Doc, Troy, and Archie point guns at the Iraqi in a staged execution to extract information.
memories.memory_text: I worked with Doc and Troy to pressure the Iraqi, pulling out the infrared map and pointing my gun along with them to force answers.

grounded_facts: The Friendly Iraqi offers to lead the group to the gold's location after being threatened.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi point to the map and say he would take us to the bunker where the gold is now.

grounded_facts: Two bodies are dragged from the cab of the truck by Iraqi soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Iraqi soldiers drag two bodies from the cab of the truck.

grounded_facts: The driver of the tanker truck is killed during the attack.
memories.memory_text: I saw that the driver was dead after the attack, and I watched Iraqi soldiers pull the bodies from the cab.

grounded_facts: A woman pleads for medical help for her injured child.
memories.memory_text: I saw a woman holding her shirtless young son with a bandaged chest, pleading for hospital help.

grounded_facts: Doc pushes away a woman seeking medical help.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Doc push the woman away from the Humvee after she asked for medical help.

grounded_facts: A man grabs Archie while appealing for American help.
memories.memory_text: A man grabbed me while shouting 'America help,' appealing directly to me for assistance.

grounded_facts: Troy forcibly removes a civilian who grabbed Archie.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy forcibly shove the man off the vehicle after he grabbed me.

grounded_facts: Archie orders and Troy distributes MREs to the crowd.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Troy to give out MREs, and he started handing them to the crowd to keep things under control.

grounded_facts: Archie shoves the friendly Iraqi out of the moving Hummer.
memories.memory_text: I shoved the friendly Iraqi out of the moving Hummer, and he landed on his ass while the Shiites swarmed around him.

grounded_facts: Archie forcibly removes Shiite civilians from the Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I shoved the Shiite civilians out of the Humvee to clear the vehicle and regain control of the situation.

grounded_facts: An attack on a tanker truck results in chaos, milk spillage, and civilian response.
memories.memory_text: I saw milk exploding everywhere around the Humvee, gushing around our feet, and as we pulled away, I looked back at the chaos and the spilled milk.

grounded_facts: The tanker truck's container is exploded, releasing milk everywhere.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi soldier fire a grenade launcher at the tanker truck, and then milk exploded everywhere, gushing around the Humvee and our feet as Troy and I looked back while pulling away.

grounded_facts: Archie takes off his gas suit in frustration and heat, revealing his sweat-drenched clothes underneath.
memories.memory_text: I was so overheated and frustrated that I ripped off my gas suit, and I could feel the sweat pouring out of me, drenching my T-shirt underneath.

grounded_facts: Following Archie's lead, the others remove their gas suits due to heat and exhaustion.
memories.memory_text: I saw the others follow my lead and take off their gas suits too, all of them drenched in sweat just like me.

grounded_facts: Vig fails to understand what a civil war is, prompting Troy to explain it.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig ask how it could be the civil war, and I saw Troy step in to explain that it's a war inside the same country.

grounded_facts: Archie hands out unmarked Marine uniforms to the group, signaling a shift in identity and plan.
memories.memory_text: I handed out Marine uniforms to the group to make it clear we were moving forward as a unit, even if it meant forcing the identity on them.

grounded_facts: Troy refuses to put on the Marine uniform, expressing fear about personal risk and postwar consequences.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy refuse to put on the uniform, and he told me he couldn't take the risk because he has a family and doesn't want to face lifelong consequences after the war's already over.

grounded_facts: Archie repeatedly asks Troy what is most important in life, pushing him to reflect despite Troy's resistance.
memories.memory_text: I kept asking Troy what the most important thing in life was, pushing him to answer even though he resisted.

grounded_facts: Archie explains that 'necessity' governs actions, justifying their mission and the broader war logic.
memories.memory_text: I explained that necessity is what governs what happens in life, and that it justifies why we don't take out Saddam and why he has to eliminate the Shiites to stay in power.

grounded_facts: Archie counters Troy's fear of being shot by arguing that locals are too afraid of them to attack.
memories.memory_text: I told the group they didn't touch us because we decimated their country — they're scared shitless of us, and I said there's time to try another bunker.

grounded_facts: After discussion, the group agrees to proceed to another bunker to continue their mission.
memories.memory_text: After I made my case, I heard Troy and the others agree to go — Troy said 'Let's do it' and the other one said 'Rock and roll,' so we're moving forward.

grounded_facts: Troy refuses the uniform but puts on a kevlar vest, signaling conditional compliance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy refuse the uniform but put on a kevlar vest, saying he'd wear it as a necessity, and I understood it as his way of conditionally committing to the mission while protecting himself.

grounded_facts: The Hummer arrives at the entrance of an underground bunker in a village piazza, marking the start of a military intervention.
memories.memory_text: I arrived in the Hummer at the entrance of an underground bunker in a village piazza, marking the start of our intervention.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates uses a megaphone to declare U.S. military presence and order compliance.
memories.memory_text: I used the megaphone to declare our presence as U.S. Marines and ordered the soldiers to put their weapons down.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc verbally order the Iraqi soldiers to surrender their weapons.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy and Doc order the Iraqi soldiers to surrender their weapons before moving to subdue them.

grounded_facts: A U.S. military operation conducted in a village piazza to secure an underground bunker and neutralize local resistance.
memories.memory_text: I inferred this was a coordinated operation to secure the bunker and neutralize resistance in the piazza, though I didn't know all the details at the time.

grounded_facts: Doc subdues and restrains an Iraqi soldier who had fled upon seeing the approaching team.
memories.memory_text: I led Troy and Doc down a narrow bunker corridor, and when an Iraqi soldier saw us and fled, I ran past him with Troy while Doc came up behind and slammed him down to cuff him.

grounded_facts: Archie kicks open a door and enters a room in the bunker, initiating the team's movement into a new space.
memories.memory_text: I kicked open the door and went in, leading the way into the bunker room with Troy right behind me.

grounded_facts: Archie declares the U.S. Marines' authority to confiscate Kuwaiti property under the cease-fire agreement.
memories.memory_text: I declared our authority to confiscate all Kuwaiti property under the cease-fire agreement signed in Safwan.

grounded_facts: Doc strikes a resisting Iraqi with his pistol, causing it to fire accidentally, prompting everyone to duck.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc smack a resisting Iraqi with his pistol, and it went off accidentally, making everyone duck.

grounded_facts: Archie criticizes Doc for hitting a prisoner with his pistol after it discharges accidentally.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc never to hit anyone with his pistol after it fired by accident.

grounded_facts: A U.S. military operation to secure an Iraqi bunker containing looted goods and personnel.
memories.memory_text: I led the raid on the bunker, bursting in with Troy to secure the looted goods and personnel inside.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Captain offers Archie a Cuisinart for his wife, which Archie declines with a personal remark.
memories.memory_text: I was offered a Cuisinart by the Iraqi Captain for my wife, but I told him I've been divorced three times.

grounded_facts: Troy forces a kneeling Iraqi loading a CD to lie face down and cuffs him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy force the Iraqi who was loading a CD to lie face down and then cuff his hands.

grounded_facts: Doc punches a resisting Iraqi twice, causing him to cry.
memories.memory_text: I think Doc punched the resisting Iraqi twice, which made him start crying, though I didn't see it directly.

grounded_facts: Archie demands to know the location of gold from the Iraqi Captain under threat of death.
memories.memory_text: I demanded the location of the gold from the Iraqi Captain, telling him to talk so we wouldn't have to kill him.

grounded_facts: Troy identifies and points to a narrow door leading to another room, which Archie kicks open.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy point to a narrow door in the corner and say there was another room, so I kicked the door open to check it out.

grounded_facts: Archie backhands the Iraqi Sergeant and steps on his wrist to disarm him.
Archie physically assaults the Iraqi Sergeant and takes his pistol after pulling a cable from the water box.
memories.memory_text: I walked over and pulled the cable out of the water box, then backhanded the Iraqi Sergeant so hard he flew into the corner, and I stepped on his wrist to take his pistol.

grounded_facts: A scene in which Shiite captives are held in a water-filled box and others are bound and gagged while military personnel conduct or observe interrogation activities.
memories.memory_text: I saw a naked man sitting in a shallow box of water, shaking, and then I noticed ten other Shiites across the room—men, women, and children—bound and gagged, which made me move toward them, but an interrogator blocked my way and I stared at him with contempt.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator attempts to de-escalate tension by offering to move the captives outside to avoid bothering Archie.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Interrogator that they would take the captives outside so it wouldn't bother me.

grounded_facts: Ten Shiite captives, including women and children, are taken out of the inner room through a rear door after the Interrogator negotiates with Archie.
memories.memory_text: I saw the disarmed Iraqi Sergeant open a rear door and push the ten Shiite captives, including women and children, out of the inner room after I intervened.

grounded_facts: After disarming the Sergeant and witnessing the removal of the captives, Archie points his pistol at the Captain and demands to be taken to the basement.
Archie points his pistol directly at the Captain's face to enforce compliance.
memories.memory_text: After I disarmed the sergeant and saw the captives being moved, I walked back and pointed my pistol at the Captain's face, demanding he take us to the basement.

grounded_facts: Archie and the group arrive at Bunker Number Two after descending cement stairs, marking the start of a new phase in their mission.
memories.memory_text: I led the group down several narrow cement stairs into Bunker Number Two, marking the start of a new phase in our mission.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Captain expresses fear that Saddam will execute him over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi Captain say he was afraid Saddam would shoot him dead over the situation.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator responds by suggesting Saddam is more concerned about the Shiite than the gold.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Interrogator responding that Saddam worries more about the Shiite than the gold.

grounded_facts: Archie enters through the door, followed by the Iraqi Interrogator and Captain, advancing the group's position.
memories.memory_text: I went through the door, with the Iraqi Interrogator and Captain following me, moving us forward into the room.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Captain violently attacks Doc by jumping on his back and choking him, likely in response to the looting of the suitcases.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi Captain suddenly jump on Doc's back and choke him, so I watched Troy punch him and pull him off, then I drew my pistol and held it to the man's face to regain control.

grounded_facts: Archie orders Doc and Troy to return the jewelry they stole from the suitcases, insisting they stick to the original plan of taking only gold.
Archie uses verbal and physical dominance (pointing a gun) to assert control over the distribution of loot, ordering Doc and Troy to return stolen jewelry.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc and Troy to put the jewelry back and stick to the plan—only gold—and I made sure they followed my order, even pointing my gun to make it clear I was in charge.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Troy discover that multiple Louis Vuitton suitcases contain bricks of gold, each weighing five kilos, with sixty bricks per suitcase, leading to a total estimate of thirty million dollars.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Doc and Troy as we opened the suitcases, and when we saw the gold bricks—each five kilos, sixty to a case—I couldn't believe it; we kept checking and found more, and I realized we were looking at around thirty million dollars.

grounded_facts: A group of soldiers inspects a series of Louis Vuitton suitcases in a bunker and discovers they are filled with gold bricks, leading to shock, discussion, and attempts to move the loot.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Troy and Doc as we opened the Louis Vuitton suitcases and found one filled with gold Cartier watches, then another with Kuwaiti passports, and finally the big one with gold bricks—sixty in each suitcase, ten suitcases total, worth thirty million dollars. We all froze in shock, then tried lifting them like tabletops, but one ripped open and spilled gold everywhere, nearly crushing Troy's foot.

grounded_facts: The suitcases, unable to bear the weight of the gold bricks, rip apart when lifted, causing gold to spill onto the floor and injure Troy.
memories.memory_text: I helped Doc and Troy lift one of the suitcases sideways because it was so heavy, but suddenly it ripped apart and gold spilled everywhere— one of the bars landed on Troy's foot and hurt him.

grounded_facts: Doc explains that the suitcases cannot support the weight of the gold due to insufficient tensile strength, based on his knowledge from working at an airport.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Doc that the suitcases can't handle the weight of the gold because their tensile strength isn't strong enough, based on what he knows from working at an airport.

grounded_facts: The group gathers in the bunker basement to pack gold bars into Louis Vuitton bags, discussing logistics and risks.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group gathers in the bunker basement to pack gold bars into Louis Vuitton bags, discussing logistics and risks.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc pressure Archie to disclose how the gold will be shipped, showing distrust.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Troy and Doc pressure Archie to disclose how the gold will be shipped, showing distrust.

grounded_facts: Archie reveals the full smuggling route for the gold, involving French Special Forces, oil barrels, and multiple international transfers.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie reveals the full smuggling route for the gold, involving French Special Forces, oil barrels, and multiple international transfers.

grounded_facts: Archie explains the international smuggling route for the gold in response to Troy and Doc's insistence.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie explains the international smuggling route for the gold in response to Troy and Doc's insistence.

grounded_facts: Troy points out that the current containers won't fit in the Humvee, implying a flaw in the plan.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Troy points out that the current containers won't fit in the Humvee, implying a flaw in the plan.

grounded_facts: The group decides they need a trailer to transport the gold bars because the hat boxes won't fit in the Humvee.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group decides they need a trailer to transport the gold bars because the hat boxes won't fit in the Humvee.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and the Interrogator are moving up a narrow cement staircase while carrying Vuitton cases, indicating urgency or evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I was running up a narrow cement staircase with Doc and the Interrogator, each of us carrying Vuitton cases, and I could feel the urgency in every step we took.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major warmly greets and embraces the Interrogator, signaling alliance or prior connection.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi Major warmly greet and embrace the Interrogator, signaling they had some kind of alliance or past connection.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi Major salutes Archie, acknowledging his authority or role in the operation.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Iraqi Major saluting me, acknowledging my role in the operation.

grounded_facts: Archie confirms with the Iraqi Major that they are taking the Kuwaiti gold, marking a commitment to the theft and collaboration with the Major.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to the Iraqi Major that we would take the Kuwaiti gold, making it clear we were going through with the theft together.

grounded_facts: At the Iraqi Major's command, soldiers 6 & 7 are assigned to help load the luggage, indicating cooperation between the group and Iraqi forces.
memories.memory_text: After I said we could load the luggage ourselves, the Iraqi Major ordered soldiers 6 and 7 to help us, and they came over ready to assist.

grounded_facts: The Interrogator tells Archie to leave the area quickly, emphasizing the danger or moral weight of the situation.
memories.memory_text: I was told to leave the area quickly, and the warning made me feel the weight of what was happening.

grounded_facts: Archie notices blood on an Iraqi soldier's hands and face, leading to heightened awareness of recent violence.
memories.memory_text: I saw blood on an Iraqi soldier's hands and face, and it made me realize how violent things had just been.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter outside Bunker Number Two where the protagonists meet the Iraqi Major amid ongoing violence against Shiites, negotiate the gold's transfer, and prepare to leave.
memories.memory_text: I remember the tense moment outside Bunker Number Two, where we met the Iraqi Major amid violence against Shiites, negotiated the gold transfer, and prepared to leave with his soldiers' help.

grounded_facts: After witnessing the violence and confirming the gold's acquisition, Archie orders the group to load up and depart.
memories.memory_text: After seeing the blood and knowing the gold was secured, I ordered my group to load up and get out of there.

grounded_facts: Archie challenges the Iraqi Major's actions using the Geneva Convention as moral leverage.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie challenges the Iraqi Major's actions using the Geneva Convention as moral leverage.

grounded_facts: Troy reminds Archie that their mission is about gold, not saving people.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Troy reminds Archie that their mission is about gold, not saving people.

grounded_facts: After the cart fails, the group decides to load supplies into a truck instead.
memories.memory_text: After the cart collapsed, I was told we should take the truck instead, and someone reminded me about sticking to the original plan for gold.

grounded_facts: Archie offers gold in exchange for allowing Shiite prisoners to leave with them.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie offers gold in exchange for allowing Shiite prisoners to leave with them.

grounded_facts: Iraqi Major rejects Archie's offer of gold to free Shiite prisoners, citing fear of Saddam's retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I offered the Iraqi Major gold to free the Shiite prisoners, but he refused and told me Saddam would kill him if he let them go, so he ordered me to leave.

grounded_facts: Archie instructs Troy and others to provide armed cover during his intervention.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie instructs Troy and others to provide armed cover during his intervention.

grounded_facts: An Iraqi soldier attacks the Man in Glasses and the Girl; Archie intervenes, disarms the soldier, and rescues them.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in when the soldier attacked the man protecting the girl, grabbed his wrist, disarmed him, and got them both to safety by the Humvee.

grounded_facts: Iraqi soldiers hold Shiite prisoners, including a woman and a man with a girl, under armed guard near bunker two.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi soldiers holding the Shiite prisoners near bunker two, including a woman and a man with a girl, all under armed guard, and I watched as they pulled the woman away and shot her, then attacked the man when he tried to protect the girl.

grounded_facts: Archie orders his team to cover him as he confronts Iraqi soldiers, leading to mutual gunpoint.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Archie orders his team to cover him as he confronts Iraqi soldiers, leading to mutual gunpoint.

grounded_facts: Iraqi soldiers seize and execute a raped Shiite woman in front of the Americans.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Iraqi soldiers pull a woman from the group and shoot her dead right in front of us, and I heard the girl in arm casts scream as they went after her next.

grounded_facts: Iraqi 6 shoots Archie; Troy kills Iraqi 6; Iraqi 7 shoots Troy; Doc and Vig return fire, killing Iraqi 7 and two others; Archie kills Iraqi Major.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Iraqi 6 shoots Archie; Troy kills Iraqi 6; Iraqi 7 shoots Troy; Doc and Vig return fire, killing Iraqi 7 and two others; Archie kills Iraqi Major.

grounded_facts: Troy is shot in the chest but survives due to kevlar; bullet falls out of vest dent.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Troy is shot in the chest but survives due to kevlar; bullet falls out of vest dent.

grounded_facts: After the firefight, surviving Iraqi soldiers drop weapons and surrender.
memories.memory_text: I remember that After the firefight, surviving Iraqi soldiers drop weapons and surrender.

grounded_facts: Doc questions Troy's lack of empathy by asking him to imagine being a prisoner.
Doc challenges Troy by asking him to imagine being in the prisoners' position.
Troy displays his Kevlar vest with a bullet impact to argue against risking lives for others.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc challenge Troy by asking him to imagine being a prisoner, and I saw Troy respond by pointing to his Kevlar vest, showing the bullet impact as if that justified leaving others behind.

grounded_facts: Archie insists that space be made in the vehicles for the Shiite prisoners despite resistance from Troy.
Archie forcefully orders Troy to obey and make room for the prisoners.
Troy challenges Archie's decision to evacuate prisoners, citing mission necessity and personal risk.
memories.memory_text: I insisted we make room in the vehicles for the Shiite prisoners, and when Troy challenged me, questioning mission necessity, I ordered him to obey—I had to enforce the decision to evacuate them.

grounded_facts: The team starts vehicles and begins evacuation with prisoners.
memories.memory_text: I saw the team start the vehicles and load the prisoners—I jumped into the Humvee with Vig while the others crammed the Shiites, the man in glasses, and the little girl into the back before we pulled away.

grounded_facts: An approaching Iraqi tank is unable to engage as its turret becomes stuck, halting immediate threat.
memories.memory_text: As we were evacuating, I saw the Iraqi tank approaching, but its turret jammed—I noticed it whining and stuck, unable to fire, which gave us the chance to get away.

grounded_facts: Doc treats Archie's gunshot wound in his lower left arm with disinfectant and bandages it.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sting of disinfectant as Doc treated my gunshot wound in my lower left arm and then bandaged it.

grounded_facts: The tank is turning into position to target the Humvee, observed through Doc's binoculars.
memories.memory_text: I saw through Doc's binoculars that the tank was turning into position to target the Humvee, and I realized we were being lined up.

grounded_facts: Archie tells Vig to stay on the road, showing concern for safety and asserting control.
memories.memory_text: I told Vig to stay on the road because I needed to keep us safe and in control.

grounded_facts: Due to distraction while searching for his gas mask, Vig steers the Humvee off the road into the desert.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get distracted while looking for his gas mask and drive the Humvee off the road into the desert.

grounded_facts: The Humvee drives into a visible minefield and hits a mine, causing an explosion and destruction of the vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I saw the minefield right ahead on the sand and realized we were driving into it—I shouted 'Mine' just before the explosion hit and destroyed the Humvee.

grounded_facts: Doc announces that the cloud from the explosion is gas, providing critical information.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc shout 'Gas' right after the explosion, so I knew the cloud was dangerous.

grounded_facts: A group travels by Humvee across the desert during daylight when an aerial attack and subsequent mine explosion disrupt the journey.
memories.memory_text: I was traveling in the Humvee across the desert during the day when everything went wrong.

grounded_facts: A rocket explodes in the sky above the Humvee, releasing a brown gas cloud.
memories.memory_text: I saw the rocket streak across the sky and then explode right above us, releasing a brown gas cloud near the Humvee.

grounded_facts: Archie and others jump out of the moving Humvee to escape the imminent mine explosion.
memories.memory_text: I saw the minefield ahead and realized we had to get out fast, so I dove from the moving Humvee to escape the explosion, and the others followed me.

grounded_facts: A dense brown fog descends around the survivors, causing respiratory distress and requiring gas masks.
memories.memory_text: I saw the dense brown fog descend around us, and I knew we all needed gas masks to breathe.

grounded_facts: Troy sees two children running across the minefield and chases after them despite the danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy chasing after two children running across the minefield, though I couldn't reach them in time.

grounded_facts: After seeing Archie give his mask to the Little Girl, Doc removes his own mask and gives it to the Shiite Man in Glasses.
Archie gives his gas mask to the Little Girl with arm casts; Doc gives his to the Shiite Man in Glasses after seeing Archie's action.
memories.memory_text: I gave my gas mask to the Little Girl with arm casts, and I saw Doc take off his own mask and give it to the Shiite Man in Glasses after that.

grounded_facts: Vig sustains facial injuries from shrapnel, losing vision in one eye and requiring assistance.
memories.memory_text: I think Vig was hit by shrapnel in his eye and couldn't see well, and I noticed he was struggling until Doc helped him with his glasses and guided his hand.

grounded_facts: Archie stops Doc from injecting himself with a syringe, correctly identifying the gas as non-lethal C.S.
memories.memory_text: I stopped Doc from injecting himself with the syringe because I knew the gas wasn't sarin and we'd still be alive if it were lethal.

grounded_facts: Archie identifies the brown fog as C.S. gas, not sarin or mustard gas, and explains it is non-lethal but extremely irritating.
memories.memory_text: I identified the brown fog as C.S. gas, not sarin or mustard gas, and told Doc it was non-lethal but extremely irritating—like tear gas times ten.

grounded_facts: Doc tells Vig he will die if he doesn't comply, attempting to coerce him into the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc say to Vig, 'You're gonna die,' trying to force him into the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Vig and Doc engage in a physical fight after Doc insists on entering the tunnel.
Vig jerks his arm away and punches Doc when grabbed.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig jerk his arm away and punch Doc when he was grabbed, and then they started fighting, falling to the ground and hitting each other.

grounded_facts: Archie calls out and searches for Barlow in the haze.
memories.memory_text: I called out for Barlow and searched for him in the haze, trying to find him despite the thick air.

grounded_facts: Archie chokes and vomits into the sand while searching for Troy in the haze.
memories.memory_text: I choked and vomited into the sand while I was still looking for Troy, my body giving in to the harsh conditions.

grounded_facts: A group of thirty black-robed figures appear in the desert haze, take control of the situation, and lead the Shiites and then the main characters toward a hidden tunnel.
The group notices a 4-foot high tunnel entrance in a mound of desert earth, where black-robed figures lead the Shiites.
memories.memory_text: I saw thirty black-robed figures appear in the haze, take control, and lead the Shiites away; then I noticed a 4-foot high tunnel entrance in a mound where they were being taken, and I was pulled toward it by one of them.

grounded_facts: Black-robed figures physically drag Archie, Doc, and Vig toward and into the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I was disoriented and trying to keep my bearings in the thick air when black-robed figures appeared, grabbing me, Doc, and Vig and pulling us toward the tunnel—I remember one of them taking me by the arm and forcing me inside against my will.

grounded_facts: A group struggles through a low tunnel under hazardous conditions, attempting to flee after a violent incident involving Troy's death.
memories.memory_text: I was there in the low tunnel, choking and struggling through the chaos with everyone, trying to flee after what happened to Troy.

grounded_facts: Archie screams at Vig, rejecting the idea of abandoning Troy's body and accusing Vig of moral failure.
Archie asserts that he cannot abandon Troy's body after the violent incident, emphasizing moral responsibility over escape with gold.
memories.memory_text: I screamed at Vig that I couldn't leave Troy's body behind and take the gold like nothing happened—I told him if he could do that, I hoped he'd die right then, because walking away from that was a crime.

grounded_facts: Doc hands a bandage to Archie so he can treat Vig's injury.
Archie applies a bandage to Vig's wounded eye socket, providing medical aid under duress.
memories.memory_text: I took the bandage from Doc and used it to cover Vig's wounded eye socket, helping him as best I could in the moment.

grounded_facts: Archie discovers the minaret in the desert and leads Doc and Vig toward it, marking the beginning of their exploration.
memories.memory_text: I climbed out of a small mound in the desert, looked around, and led Doc and Vig toward the minaret I spotted in the distance.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig enter the ancient minaret through its old wooden doorway.
memories.memory_text: I entered the ancient minaret through its old wooden doorway with Doc and Vig behind me.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig make eye contact with a line of injured children upon entering the minaret hallway, establishing initial awareness between the groups.
memories.memory_text: I made eye contact with a line of injured children as Doc, Vig, and I entered the minaret hallway, and in that moment, we all became aware of each other.

grounded_facts: Archie endures painful treatment as a cleric shoots alcohol into his infected wound.
memories.memory_text: I endured intense pain when a cleric shot alcohol into my infected wound using a turkey baster, and I couldn't help but scream.

grounded_facts: A group of injured people, including Archie and Vig, receive treatment from Shiite clerics in a large room.
memories.memory_text: I was in a large room with a group of injured people, including Vig, and we were all receiving treatment from Shiite clerics.

grounded_facts: Vig reaches out to Doc as a gesture of apology and connection.
Vig expresses remorse for hitting Doc earlier, citing fear for Troy, and reaches out for reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig reach out to Doc, saying he was sorry for hitting him because he was scared for Troy, and then he held out his hand — Doc took it, and they stayed quiet like that for a moment.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig inspect and count the remaining gold suitcases.
memories.memory_text: I inspected the remaining gold suitcases with Doc and Vig, checking how much we still had after everything that happened.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig inspect the Luggage and confirm 92 suitcases remain, missing 28.
memories.memory_text: I checked the Luggage with Doc and Vig, and after counting, I confirmed we had 92 suitcases left and were missing 28.

grounded_facts: Archie takes responsibility for the day's decisions and offers Doc and Vig the option to return without him.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc and Vig that the day's choices were mine, and I gave them the option to head back while I go after Barlow alone.

grounded_facts: After consideration, Doc decides to stay and help rescue Barlow.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc hesitate and think it over, and then he told me he was staying to help rescue Barlow.

grounded_facts: Imam Katar discloses that Barlow was captured and taken to the Oasis Bunker, 17-18 klicks away.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Barlow was captured and taken to the Oasis Bunker, about 17 to 18 klicks from here.

grounded_facts: Imam suggests the group is stealing gold, not conducting a military rescue.
memories.memory_text: I was told the group was suspected of stealing gold, not rescuing a soldier.

grounded_facts: Archie agrees to give 10 suitcases of gold to Imam Katar in exchange for guides, weapons, and fighters to reach Oasis Bunker.
memories.memory_text: I agreed to give ten suitcases of gold to Imam Katar in exchange for guides, weapons, and fighters to reach the Oasis Bunker.

grounded_facts: Imam Katar adds that the deal is void unless the group helps his people reach the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I learned that Imam Katar would only honor the deal if we helped his people reach the Iranian border.

grounded_facts: The group negotiates with Imam Katar to secure help for rescuing Barlow.
memories.memory_text: I negotiated with Imam Katar, trying to secure help to rescue Barlow by discussing options like finding a vehicle or getting to a refugee camp, even though we had no radio or easy way to call for backup.

grounded_facts: Doc dumps a suitcase of gold to motivate someone to guide them to Oasis Bunker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc dump a suitcase of gold to push someone into guiding us to the Oasis Bunker.

grounded_facts: Archie asks Doc whether anything was saved from the Humvee, indicating concern for available resources.
memories.memory_text: I asked Doc if we saved anything from the Humvee because I was worried about what resources we had left.

grounded_facts: Archie looks at Doc with a nonverbal expression indicating disappointment or sarcasm after learning only the bag was saved.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Doc like 'Great' after he told me only the bag was saved, because I knew it wasn't much to work with.

grounded_facts: Archie constructs two improvised explosive devices using footballs, plastic explosive, nails, and fuses.
memories.memory_text: I constructed two explosive devices using footballs, wrapping plastic explosive around each one, pressing nails into the material, and inserting fuses, even though my arm was in pain while doing it.

grounded_facts: Archie leads a group of 55 Shiites across the desert, each carrying at least one Vuitton bag, with Imam carrying his daughter.
memories.memory_text: I led a group of 55 Shiites across the desert, each carrying at least one Vuitton bag, and I saw Imam carrying his daughter.

grounded_facts: DOC corrects VIG's confusion between 'Iman' and 'Imam', emphasizing the difference in spelling and identity.
memories.memory_text: I heard DOC correct VIG, saying 'That's Im-an, with an n. He's Imam with an m,' but I could tell VIG wasn't convinced.

grounded_facts: Archie issues a formal military command for the truck's occupants to surrender.
memories.memory_text: I issued a command for the occupants of the truck to surrender, asserting my authority in the situation.

grounded_facts: Vig expresses regret after accidentally firing his weapon.
memories.memory_text: I heard Vig say 'Shit. Sorry.' after he fired his weapon, showing he regretted the accidental shot.

grounded_facts: Vig accidentally fires his pistol, revealing that the Iraqi military truck is a decoy made of canvas.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig accidentally fire his pistol, and the shot revealed the so-called military truck was just a collapsing canvas decoy.

grounded_facts: Archie and Doc realize the deflated truck is part of a larger deception strategy using decoys to mislead coalition bombers.
memories.memory_text: I realized the deflated truck was part of a larger enemy deception strategy, and I told Doc they used a lot of decoys to throw off our bombers.

grounded_facts: Imam provides information about a place where deserters might have vehicles.
Imam proposes a location where deserters may have vehicles available.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Imam that he knows a place full of deserters and that they might have something we can use.

grounded_facts: The group starts walking in single file through the desert, following Archie, who carries a Vuitton bag.
memories.memory_text: I led the group walking in single file through the desert, carrying the Vuitton bag while they followed behind me.

grounded_facts: Shiite fighters shout expressions of gratitude and friendship toward America while patting Archie, Doc, and Vig on the back.
memories.memory_text: I heard Shiite fighters shouting gratitude and friendship toward America while they patted me, Doc, and Vig on the back.

grounded_facts: Two Iraqi soldiers emerge from the bunker and embrace Archie and Doc, who appear disoriented.
memories.memory_text: I felt disoriented when two Iraqi soldiers emerged and embraced me and Doc.

grounded_facts: Archie, Doc, and Vig arrive at a bunker in a Shiite-controlled area, where they are greeted by Shiite fighters and Iraqi soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at a bunker in a Shiite-controlled area with Doc and Vig, where we were greeted by Shiite fighters and Iraqi soldiers.

grounded_facts: A gathering at the deserter's bunker where Shiite fighters and Iraqi soldiers greet Archie, Doc, and Vig with cheers and physical gestures of friendship.
memories.memory_text: I remember a gathering at the bunker where Shiite fighters and Iraqi soldiers cheered and reached out to us with embraces and pats on the back.

grounded_facts: A friendly Iraqi soldier offers a live monkey to Archie as food, indicating their dire situation and hospitality despite scarcity.
memories.memory_text: I saw one of the Iraqi soldiers offer me a live monkey as food, and though I declined, I understood it as a gesture of hospitality despite their dire circumstances.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi soldier informs Archie that there is no water or radio, denying access to critical survival and communication resources.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Iraqi soldier that there's no water or radio here, so I know we're cut off from basic supplies and communication.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi soldier embraces Archie after expressing belief that George Bush will remove Saddam, showing goodwill despite political misunderstanding.
memories.memory_text: I was embraced by an Iraqi soldier who believed George Bush would remove Saddam, showing goodwill even though I knew it was based on a misunderstanding.

grounded_facts: An encounter between Archie's group and young Iraqi soldiers in a bunker, involving communication, offers of food, and requests for aid.
memories.memory_text: I remember entering the bunker with my group and seeing young Iraqi soldiers watching CNN; they half-bowed to me, one of them offered me a live monkey as food, and later I asked the Imam to explain to them that we needed a vehicle to escape.

grounded_facts: Archie asks Imam to explain their need for a vehicle to the Iraqi soldiers, signaling intent to leave the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I asked Imam to explain to the Iraqi soldiers that we needed a vehicle of some kind, so they'd understand we wanted to leave the bunker.

grounded_facts: Doc asks whether Lexus makes the convertible model present in the garage.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc ask if Lexus makes the convertible in the garage.

grounded_facts: The group discovers an underground garage filled with nine luxury cars taken from Kuwait.
A gathering in an underground garage where American soldiers discover stolen luxury cars and attempt to rally Iraqi deserters to join a rebellion.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the underground garage with Doc and Vig, staring in amazement as the lights came up and revealed nine luxury cars taken from Kuwait, and I felt the weight of what this could mean—we could use these vehicles to rally the Iraqi deserters and start a rebellion.

grounded_facts: Archie attempts to inspire the Iraqi deserters to rise up against Saddam by framing a shared struggle for freedom.
Archie delivers an impassioned speech calling for unity and uprising against Saddam, invoking American ideals.
memories.memory_text: I stood before the Iraqi deserters and called for us to rise up together, united in a shared struggle for freedom, invoking George Bush and the promise of American support, ending with a blessing for a free Iraq.

grounded_facts: Despite the cheers, the Iraqi soldiers refuse to give the cars, citing lack of resources and survival needs.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Iraqi soldier tell me they couldn't give us the cars because they had no money and needed it to eat and survive.

grounded_facts: Archie asserts authority as U.S. military and demands the use of cars to fight Saddam's forces.
memories.memory_text: I asserted that we are the United States military and demanded the use of the cars to fight Saddam's soldiers, knowing we might have to buy them if they wouldn't give them up.

grounded_facts: The 92 Vuitton suitcases containing gold are buried in a trench and marked with a stake by Archie.
memories.memory_text: I buried the 92 Vuitton suitcases of gold in the trench and drove a stake into the ground to mark the spot so we can find it later.

grounded_facts: Archie makes it clear that the Imam's people will not survive unless the full gold is recovered after capturing Troy.
memories.memory_text: I made it clear to the Imam that my gold wasn't here, and unless all of it was recovered after we captured Troy, his people would not survive.

grounded_facts: Doc and Vig remove distributor caps from the Cadillacs and Limousine to disable them, keeping the caps in Doc's pack.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc and Vig remove the distributor caps from the Cadillacs and the Limousine, making sure the vehicles couldn't be used, and I knew they kept the caps in Doc's pack.

grounded_facts: Vig voices his fear that the group will be killed during the mission.
memories.memory_text: I remember Vig telling me he had a bad feeling we were going to get killed on this mission.

grounded_facts: Archie uses singing Bach's 'Gloria' to calm Vig's anxiety, eventually getting him to join in.
memories.memory_text: I sang Bach's 'Gloria' loud and put my hands on Vig's shoulders to calm him down, and eventually he joined in with me.

grounded_facts: A group meeting in the desert where the plan to retrieve Troy is confirmed, vehicles are disabled, and emotional tensions are addressed.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the group meeting in the desert where I confirmed our plan to drive in and get Troy, and when Vig expressed fear, I put my hands on his shoulders and sang Bach loudly to steady him—we ended up singing together.

grounded_facts: Archie drives the Mercedes rapidly past the guards, skidding around the right side of the bunker to the back side, evading immediate capture or confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I drove the Mercedes fast past the guards, skidding around the right side of the bunker through the sand to get to the back, avoiding a direct fight.

grounded_facts: Archie lights the fuse of a plastic explosive containing nails, preparing to deploy it into the bunker's ventilation system.
memories.memory_text: I lit the fuse of the plastic explosive packed with nails, preparing to deploy it into the bunker's ventilation system.

grounded_facts: Archie drops the lit plastic explosive into the bunker's ventilation shaft after Imam removes the vent grill.
Archie acts immediately after Imam opens the vent, using the access point to deploy the explosive.
memories.memory_text: As soon as Imam removed the vent grill, I dropped the lit plastic explosive into the bunker's ventilation shaft.

grounded_facts: A coordinated attempt by Archie and Shiite allies to breach and destroy a bunker using explosives.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a coordinated effort with Imam and the Shiite allies to breach and destroy the bunker using explosives.

grounded_facts: The Mercedes is locked, preventing immediate access to the pistol inside.
memories.memory_text: I saw that the Mercedes was locked, so I couldn't get to my pistol at first.

grounded_facts: A gunshot from the bunker roof shatters the Mercedes window and triggers the car alarm.
memories.memory_text: I heard a gunshot from the bunker roof that shattered the Mercedes window and set off the car alarm.

grounded_facts: Archie reaches into the broken window and retrieves his pistol from the front seat.
memories.memory_text: I reached through the broken window and grabbed my pistol just before the car exploded.

grounded_facts: A launched grenade explodes the Mercedes shortly after Archie retrieves the pistol.
memories.memory_text: I saw a grenade explode the Mercedes right after I grabbed my pistol.

grounded_facts: Doc verbally confronts a Shiite fighter for continuing to fire despite his order to stop.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc shout at one of the Shiite fighters, asking him what was wrong with him for continuing to shoot even after he gave the order to stop.

grounded_facts: Doc physically grabs the rifle of a Shiite fighter to prevent further firing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc grab the rifle of a Shiite fighter to physically stop him from firing, and only then did everyone finally stop shooting.

grounded_facts: Several Iraqi soldiers surrender after being fired upon, with some dropping weapons and raising hands while others remain ambivalent.
memories.memory_text: I saw several Iraqi soldiers run out of the bunker, with some dropping their weapons and raising their hands in surrender while others looked unsure, just standing there with one holding a stack of new jeans.

grounded_facts: Doc attempts to halt firing but is disobeyed, resulting in escalation and a Shiite fighter being wounded.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc try to stop the Shiite fighters from shooting by raising his hand and yelling, but they kept firing, which made the Iraqis shoot back and one of the Shiites got hit in the face.

grounded_facts: Doc experiences a physical manifestation of fear during the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I saw that Doc was overwhelmed with fear during the confrontation—he had wet his pants.

grounded_facts: Archie arrives and pulls Doc away from the battlefield into the bunker.
Archie grabs Doc and runs with him into the bunker for protection.
memories.memory_text: I arrived and grabbed Doc, pulling him away from the battlefield and running with him into the bunker for safety.

grounded_facts: A combat engagement at the front of a bunker involving Iraqi soldiers, Shiite riflemen, and Doc's group, culminating in surrender and aerial intervention.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the chaotic firefight at the bunker where Iraqi soldiers came out, some surrendering with hands up while others hesitated, and Shiite fighters kept shooting despite Doc's efforts, until a helicopter arrived and opened fire.

grounded_facts: An Iraqi helicopter arrives and opens fire on the position, disrupting the ground engagement.
memories.memory_text: I saw the helicopter open fire and realized it was disrupting the fight on the ground, forcing Vig to take cover and the Shiites to respond to the aerial threat.

grounded_facts: Archie shoots and kills two Iraqi guards in the control room.
memories.memory_text: I kicked in the door and saw two Iraqi guards trying to fix the emergency light in the flickering dark, so I shot them both to eliminate the threat.

grounded_facts: Archie shoots the Interrogator in the thigh during confrontation.
Archie shoots the Interrogator in the thigh to incapacitate him.
memories.memory_text: I shot the Interrogator in the thigh to take him down and stop him from threatening us.

grounded_facts: Archie disconnects Troy from the interrogation equipment and cuts him loose from the chair.
memories.memory_text: I ripped the wires from the controls, went to Troy, unhinged the wire from his jaw, cut the cord binding him to the chair, and freed him.

grounded_facts: Archie gives Troy a pistol after freeing him.
Archie hands his newly acquired pistol to Troy after freeing him.
memories.memory_text: After freeing Troy, I took the Interrogator's pistol and gave it to him so he could defend himself.

grounded_facts: Troy points a pistol directly at the Interrogator's face to assert dominance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy get up and point his pistol directly into the Interrogator's face, holding him down with that stare.

grounded_facts: Troy chooses not to kill the wounded Interrogator, firing beside his head instead.
Troy points a gun at the Interrogator but chooses not to kill him, firing beside his head instead.
memories.memory_text: I watched as Troy fired his gun beside the Interrogator's head instead of killing him, then lowered the weapon looking unhappy about it.

grounded_facts: Archie locates and rescues Troy from captivity in the bunker's control room after eliminating enemy personnel.
memories.memory_text: I found Troy bound in the chair, so I ripped the wires from the controls, cut him free with a knife, gave him a pistol, and made sure he was ready to move.

grounded_facts: Doc shoots the lock on the inner door, allowing it to open.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc shoot the lock on the inner door, and then it opened.

grounded_facts: Doc discovers 50 Shiite civilians huddled together in a sunken room.
memories.memory_text: I think there were 50 Shiite civilians huddled in a sunken room inside, though I didn't see them clearly myself.

grounded_facts: Archie rushes by with Troy and calls out to move forward.
memories.memory_text: I rushed forward with Troy and called out to keep moving.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy leave the bunker.
memories.memory_text: I ran out of the bunker with Troy.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy retreat into the bunker after the grenade explosion.
A grenade fired from the helicopter explodes next to Archie and Troy, forcing them to retreat.
memories.memory_text: I was right there with Troy when a grenade fired from the hovering helicopter exploded beside us, and I immediately scrambled back into the bunker to get to safety.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy arrive at the bunker door and knock Doc over upon encountering him.
memories.memory_text: I ran into Doc at the bunker door and knocked him over when Troy and I arrived.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy crouch inside the door for cover or protection after entering.
memories.memory_text: I crouched inside the bunker door with Troy for cover right after we got in, hearing the chopper hovering outside.

grounded_facts: Archie gives the C-4 football bomb to Doc, assigning him the role of deploying the explosive.
memories.memory_text: I handed the C-4 football bomb to Doc, making sure he was ready to deploy it when the time came.

grounded_facts: Archie pretends to throw the football bomb to illustrate the correct timing and motion for deployment.
memories.memory_text: I pretended to throw the football bomb to show the right timing and motion we'd need for the real throw.

grounded_facts: Archie gives clear, directive instructions to Troy and Doc on how to execute the escape, including timing and actions.
memories.memory_text: I gave Troy and Doc clear instructions on what to do, telling them exactly when to move and how to time the throw so we could get out safely.

grounded_facts: Archie directs the group on an escape procedure, distributing tasks and demonstrating the timing for throwing a C-4 football bomb.
memories.memory_text: I directed the entire escape plan, showing the timing, assigning roles, and cutting the fuse on the bomb to prepare for our exit.

grounded_facts: Archie cuts the fuse on the football-shaped C-4 explosive, preparing it for use.
memories.memory_text: I cut the fuse on the football-shaped C-4 with my knife to get it ready for use.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by Archie, Doc, and Troy to flee the bunker using an explosive device, following Archie's instructions.
memories.memory_text: I stood at the door with Doc and Troy, ready to flee the bunker together using the explosive device as part of my plan.

grounded_facts: Archie physically stabilizes Troy's shaking hand to help him light the fuse, showing teamwork and composure under pressure.
memories.memory_text: I physically stabilized Troy's hand because I could see he was too shaky to light the fuse alone, showing we had to rely on each other under pressure.

grounded_facts: The fuse is successfully ignited with Archie's help after Troy struggles to light it due to shaking hands.
memories.memory_text: I helped Troy light the fuse by steadying his shaking hand, and we watched it ignite successfully, marking a critical step in our escape plan.

grounded_facts: After the fuse is lit, Archie instructs Troy to leave immediately, signaling urgency and transition to the next phase of their plan.
memories.memory_text: Right after the fuse lit, I told Troy to go immediately, initiating our escape and keeping us ahead of the danger.

grounded_facts: Archie and Troy exit the bunker while firing pistols, beginning their escape under fire.
memories.memory_text: I fired my pistol as I ran out of the bunker with Troy, returning fire to cover our escape.

grounded_facts: Doc throws a burning fuse ball toward the hovering chopper in an attempt to damage it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc throw a burning fuse ball at the hovering chopper, trying to take it down as we got out.

grounded_facts: Archie Gates prepares the second explosive device with a shorter fuse, indicating increased urgency.
memories.memory_text: I quickly armed the second explosive with a shorter fuse because I could feel the time running out as the helicopter approached.

grounded_facts: Troy ignites the second fuse, initiating an explosive sequence.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy light the second fuse, knowing the explosion was now imminent.

grounded_facts: Troy, Archie, and Doc exit the bunker rapidly, with Troy and Archie firing pistols and Doc carrying the ball.
memories.memory_text: I was firing my pistol as I ran out of the bunker with Troy, while Doc carried the ball between us under fire.

grounded_facts: Doc throws a football that hits the chopper, causing it to explode and crash.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc throw a football that hit the chopper and made it explode—I watched it crash right in front of us.

grounded_facts: Archie knocks down a rising Iraqi soldier and disarms him; Doc binds him with a plastic cuff.
memories.memory_text: I knocked down an Iraqi soldier who tried to rise and took his weapon before Doc cuffed him.

grounded_facts: After confirming Imam's identity, Troy embraces him in relief.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy embrace Imam after confirming who he was, and I realized he was one of the allies we could trust.

grounded_facts: Troy declares intent to help the Shiite refugees despite logistical challenges.
memories.memory_text: I heard Troy tell Doc that we weren't just stealing anymore—that we were going to help the Shiite refugees, no matter the challenges.

grounded_facts: Troy points his pistol at Imam, questioning his identity and role.
memories.memory_text: I wasn't sure who the man was at first, and when Troy questioned him, I thought he might be a soldier, but I didn't know for sure.

grounded_facts: The group secures the area after the chopper explosion, disarms enemy soldiers, and processes prisoners.
memories.memory_text: After the explosion, I helped secure the battlefield—I disarmed bodies, returned fire when needed, and directed the Shiite riflemen to spread out.

grounded_facts: Archie directs Doc and others to secure the perimeter after Vig is shot.
memories.memory_text: I told Doc to cover Vig and then directed the riflemen to lock down the perimeter and shoot anything that moves after Vig was hit.

grounded_facts: Vig is shot in the collarbone while running toward the group, continues moving briefly before collapsing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get hit in the collarbone while he was running toward us, and he staggered forward for a few steps before collapsing into Troy's arms.

grounded_facts: Troy is hit by a gunshot in the lower right chest, sustaining a penetrating wound and falling beside Vig.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy get shot in the lower right chest, and I watched him spin around from the impact before I started running toward him.

grounded_facts: Vig reunites with the group but is shot shortly after; Troy is also shot during the same exchange.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vig get shot as he was reuniting with us, and then I turned just in time to see Troy get hit too.

grounded_facts: Archie opens his waist pack and takes out a sterile scalpel, suggesting medical or surgical intent.
memories.memory_text: I opened my waist pack and took out a sterile scalpel, ready to help Troy.

grounded_facts: Imam's Little Girl gets out of the passenger side of the Jaguar and approaches the scene despite being scolded.
Imam scolds his daughter and gestures for her to return to safety.
Imam's Little Girl hugs Imam while staring down at Troy, showing emotional engagement with the situation.
While embracing her father, the Little Girl looks down at Troy with apparent recognition or concern.
memories.memory_text: I saw Imam's Little Girl get out of the Jaguar despite him scolding her and telling her to stay back, and then she hugged him while looking down at me with a look of recognition or concern.

grounded_facts: Archie performs a needle decompression on Troy's chest to release trapped air, relieving his breathing difficulty.
memories.memory_text: I exposed Troy's chest, picked the spot near his collar bone, made an incision with the scalpel, and released the trapped air that was crushing his lung—he finally breathed easier with a hiss of air escaping.

grounded_facts: Archie makes a comment indicating personal fulfillment after successfully performing the procedure.
memories.memory_text: I've been waiting 18 years to get that right, and finally I did it.

grounded_facts: An urgent medical intervention takes place in the desert after Troy is shot and develops breathing complications.
memories.memory_text: I was in the desert with Troy after he got shot and started having trouble breathing, so I knew I had to act fast to help him.

grounded_facts: Archie inserts an IV tube into the decompression site to maintain air release and possibly prepare for further treatment.
memories.memory_text: I inserted an IV tube into the same hole where I'd made the decompression to keep the air releasing and possibly set it up for further treatment.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous mourning ritual around Vig's body in the trunk of the Jaguar, involving prayer and chant by Shiite women and children, observed by Archie, Troy, and Doc.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Shiite women and children chanting and praying around Vig's body in the trunk of the Jaguar.

grounded_facts: Troy and Doc silently reenact Vig's signature Karate arm dance as a tribute to him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy and Doc quietly perform Vig's Karate arm dance as a tribute to him.

grounded_facts: Archie declares that the group is now Vig's family and takes responsibility for his remains, marking a shift in group identity and duty.
Archie removes Vig's pistol from his clenched hand, symbolizing the transfer of responsibility and legacy.
Archie gently removes Vig's glasses, a quiet act of respect and closure.
memories.memory_text: I declared that we were Vig's family, took his pistol from his hand, and gently removed his glasses to honor him.

grounded_facts: The group agrees to take Vig's body to the shrine at Kajatar in Iran, enacting his final wish.
memories.memory_text: I was told about Vig's wish to be taken to the shrine at Kajatar in Iran, and I agreed to make it happen.

grounded_facts: Archie fills a rusted oil drum with gold bars and seals it with tape.
memories.memory_text: I filled a rusted oil drum with gold bars and taped it shut to secure it for transport.

grounded_facts: Archie explains to Troy that he must release the chest tube valve every fifteen minutes to prevent pressure buildup.
memories.memory_text: I told Troy that he needs to release the chest tube valve every fifteen minutes to prevent pressure from building up.

grounded_facts: Archie releases built-up air pressure from the tube in Troy's chest, providing temporary relief.
memories.memory_text: I released the built-up air pressure from the tube in Troy's chest by opening the valve, and I saw him look relieved before I closed it again.

grounded_facts: A temporary stop in the desert where the group manages injuries and secures loot.
memories.memory_text: We made a temporary stop in the desert to deal with injuries and secure the gold; I sealed the loot in a drum while checking on Troy's condition and relieving the pressure in his chest.

grounded_facts: Archie estimates Troy can survive approximately four hours if internal bleeding does not worsen.
memories.memory_text: I told Troy he might have about four hours left if his internal bleeding doesn't get worse.

grounded_facts: Troy states he is very thirsty, indicating physical distress.
memories.memory_text: I heard Troy say he was really thirsty, and I could see he was in bad shape.

grounded_facts: DOC informs Troy that there is no available water.
memories.memory_text: I was there when DOC said there was no water available, which made things even harder for Troy.

grounded_facts: IMAM tells Archie that he has set up communication and can call his contact.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Imam that he had set up communication and I could call my contact if I wanted to.

grounded_facts: Doc voices his anxiety about facing military punishment for their actions.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc say we were going to be court-martialed, and I dismissed his fear because I didn't believe it would happen.

grounded_facts: Archie uses a radio connected to a car battery to attempt communication with 'Tar Baby' using coded language.
Archie uses a call sign to try to initiate radio contact with Tar Baby, repeating the message when no response is received.
memories.memory_text: I used the radio connected to the car battery to call Tar Baby using my call sign, Brer Rabbit, and repeated the message when I didn't get a response.

grounded_facts: Walter confirms he is responsible for executing the 'briar patch' part of the operation after initial confusion about the code.
memories.memory_text: I heard Walter confirm that he understood his responsibility for the briar patch after I corrected his misunderstanding about the code.

grounded_facts: A real-time radio communication between Walter and Archie Gates during a motorcycle ride in the desert.
Archie corrects Walter's incorrect understanding of the code phrase, indicating frustration.
memories.memory_text: I was on my motorcycle in the desert, talking to Walter over radio when he asked who handles the briar patch — I told him he does, and corrected him when he got the code backwards, saying 'No, the other way around.'

grounded_facts: Archie instructs Walter to contact Hash, arrange six personnel trucks and a Humvee, add a medavac pack, and abandon the reporter.
memories.memory_text: I instructed Walter to contact my friend Hash, arrange six personnel trucks and a Humvee with 100K per driver, add a medavac pack to the order, and dump the reporter.

grounded_facts: Walter receives new instructions from Archie via radio, including a revised code phrase and a task to arrange transportation and medical supplies.
memories.memory_text: I heard Walter confirm over the radio that he understood the new instructions, including the revised code phrase about the Tar Baby and the briar patch, and he acknowledged the tasks with a two-hour timeline.

grounded_facts: The group begins extracting water from snow globes by cracking them open and filtering the liquid, turning a symbolic object into a survival resource.
memories.memory_text: I helped crack open snow globes and filter the liquid so we could drink it, turning something symbolic into a way to survive, and I passed the water to parched Shiites who needed it.

grounded_facts: Archie, Troy, and Doc distribute filtered water to dehydrated members of the group, alleviating immediate physical need.
Archie hands over an urn of filtered water to thirsty members of the group, demonstrating care and cooperation.
memories.memory_text: I helped distribute filtered water to the parched Shiites, passing an urn to them so they could drink and recover from dehydration.

grounded_facts: Imam distributes gold bars to Shiite peasants, who conceal them and prepare to leave.
memories.memory_text: I watched Imam hand out gold bars to the Shiite peasants, who took them and hid the gold in their clothes and bags while waiting in line.

grounded_facts: Troy and Walter exchange a fist bump and banter about their mission.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy and Walter exchange a fist bump and banter about protecting the free peoples of the world before getting fixed up.

grounded_facts: A gathering at the desert bunker where medical aid is given, gold is accounted for, and the group prepares for transport.
memories.memory_text: I stayed at the bunker with Troy, Doc, and the others, where I got an IV with penicillin from Doc while we waited and kept watch as the convoy approached with the army drivers arriving to pick us up.

grounded_facts: Walter and Doc administer penicillin via IV to Troy and Archie.
memories.memory_text: I felt the IV needle go into my arm as Doc administered penicillin, just like Walter did for Troy.

grounded_facts: Havichon asks Archie about the location of the bullion.
memories.memory_text: I remember Havichon asking me where the bullion was.

grounded_facts: Walter apologizes to Archie for messing up the code.
memories.memory_text: I heard Walter apologize to me for messing up the code.

grounded_facts: A U.S. military convoy arrives at the bunker to extract the group.
memories.memory_text: I heard the rumble of approaching motors and saw a convoy of U.S. military trucks and a Humvee arrive at the bunker to extract us, and I whistled from the front seat to signal the start of the evacuation.

grounded_facts: The convoy departs the bunker with Shiites, Imam, his daughter, and the team heading toward the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I watched the convoy arrive and helped get everyone loaded up — the Shiites, Imam and his daughter, the gold in that oil can — and then I whistled from the front seat of the Humvee to signal we were moving out toward the Iranian border.

grounded_facts: The organized departure of the group in a military convoy toward the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I whistled from the front seat of the Humvee to signal the start as our convoy, with the Shiites and the gold loaded into the trucks, began moving toward the Iranian border.

grounded_facts: Havichon asks Archie what he sees, prompting clarification about the border opening.
memories.memory_text: Havichon asked me what I saw, so I told him I found an opening we could walk through, but it wouldn't fit a truck.

grounded_facts: Archie notices a gap in the border that is passable on foot but not for vehicles.
The team arrives at the Iraqi side of the border and prepares to move refugees across on foot.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a narrow opening in the border that we could walk through, but it wasn't wide enough for any vehicles, so I knew we'd have to move the refugees on foot from the Iraqi side.

grounded_facts: Archie decides the group will escort the refugees on foot to the Iranian side and return.
memories.memory_text: I decided we'd walk the refugees to the Iranian border and then return to the trucks; I announced the plan to the team.

grounded_facts: Doc turns and signals the drivers to move forward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Doc turn and signal the drivers to move forward after I gave the order.

grounded_facts: An organized movement of Shiite refugees and U.S. soldiers through a narrow opening in razor wire at an international border.
The group of Shiites, carrying Vig's body and flanked by U.S. soldiers, crosses the border through a narrow opening in the razor wire.
memories.memory_text: I led the group single file through a narrow opening in the razor wire, with the Shiites carrying Vig's body and our soldiers flanking them on both sides as we crossed the border.

grounded_facts: Doc responds to Troy's sudden dizziness by telling him to stay back, showing concern for his condition.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doc tell Troy to stay back when he got dizzy, showing he was worried about him.

grounded_facts: Troy suddenly drops to one knee and reports feeling dizzy, prompting concern from Doc.
memories.memory_text: I saw Troy suddenly drop to one knee and say he was dizzy, muttering that it wasn't the air and he didn't know what was wrong.

grounded_facts: Six Apache helicopters arrive and land between Archie and the border, blocking the path and initiating U.S. military intervention.
memories.memory_text: I heard the choppers approaching and turned to see six Apache helicopters closing in; they landed right between me and the border, kicking up dust and blocking our way forward.

grounded_facts: Captain Van Meter verbally attacks Troy during his arrest, refusing to help him breathe.
memories.memory_text: I saw Captain Van Meter lean down and shout at Troy while he was on the ground, refusing to help him breathe.

grounded_facts: Archie pleads with General Horn to provide medical attention to Troy, who is suffocating due to his restraints.
memories.memory_text: I dragged the MP holding Troy and went straight to General Horn, pleading, 'Goddamn it, Ron, give him medical attention, don't let him die.'
